1015fm.com.au.name: 101.5 FM (4OUR)
1015fm.com.au.about: 101.5 FM, branded "Moreton Bay's Own," is a community radio station serving the City of Moreton Bay region between Brisbane and the Sunshine Coast, including Caboolture, Bribie Island, Redcliffe and Woodford. It provides local news, sport, traffic and community programming for the region.

101fm.com.au.name: 101FM
101fm.com.au.about: 101FM (callsign 4CBL) is a volunteer-run community radio station owned by Radio Logan Incorporated, which was established in 1984 after Logan City Council sought interested parties to start a community station. Regular transmissions began in November 1988, and the station continues to broadcast news, entertainment, sport and local information from Logan Central to the wider Logan region.

1027.com.au.name: 102.7FM
1027.com.au.about: 102.7FM is a general-interest community radio station serving Toowoomba, the Darling Downs and the Lockyer Valley from studios in the Toowoomba CBD. Alongside general programming, it airs dedicated Dutch, Filipino, Christian and multi-faith programs for the region's diverse community.

1035fm.com.au.name: 103.5FM
1035fm.com.au.about: 103.5FM is a Christian community radio station in Orange, NSW, operated by the Canobolas Christian Broadcasters Association. It broadcasts a mix of Christian music, teaching programs and local content aimed at serving local churches and the wider Orange community.

1683amgreekradio.com.name: Hellenic Radio (Australia)
1683amgreekradio.com.about: Hellenic Radio (Australia) is a Greek-language radio station based in Marrickville, broadcasting to Sydney on 1683 kHz AM and to Melbourne on 1422 kHz. It began operating in March 1983 as a Greek-language program on the community station 2NBC, providing Greek music, news and rebroadcasts of programs such as Skai and RIK for the Australian Greek community.

1wayfm.com.au.name: 1WAY FM
1wayfm.com.au.about: 1WAY FM is a Christian community radio station broadcasting to the Canberra region from studios in Fyshwick, on 91.9 FM (94.3 FM in Tuggeranong). Run by volunteers and funded by listener support and sponsors, it plays Christian adult contemporary music alongside worship, hymns and syndicated programs such as Focus on the Family.

2ac.com.au.name: 2AC Australian Chinese Radio
2ac.com.au.about: 2AC Australian Chinese Radio is a Sydney-based station founded in 1995 by a group of Chinese-community professionals, beginning broadcast on 15 July that year. It broadcasts bilingual Cantonese and Mandarin programming 24 hours a day and describes itself as Australia's only bilingual Cantonese/Mandarin radio station.

2airfm.com.au.name: 2AIR FM
2airfm.com.au.about: 2AIR FM is a volunteer-run community radio station broadcasting to the Coffs Coast of NSW on 107.9 FM, operated by Coffs Coast Community Radio Inc. It plays an easy-listening mix spanning country, rock, folk, jazz, big-band and world music, 24 hours a day.

2arm.net.au.name: 2ARM FM
2arm.net.au.about: 2ARM FM is a community radio station serving Armidale and surrounding areas including Walcha, Uralla and Guyra. Its origins trace to a University of New England campus radio proposal in the late 1960s; it went to air as 2ARM-FM in 1976 as one of Australia's earliest community stations, and became an incorporated association in 2009.

2ay.com.au.name: 2AY
2ay.com.au.about: 2AY is a commercial radio station in Albury founded by AWA and opened on 17 December 1930, making it one of the region's oldest broadcasters. Now owned by ACE Radio Network (since 2005), it broadcasts on 1494 AM with a classic hits and talk format for the Albury-Wodonga border region.

2bbb.net.au.name: 2 Triple B FM
2bbb.net.au.about: 2BBB (2 Triple B FM) is a community radio station in Bellingen, NSW, whose origins date to a 1977 broadcasting licence application and a steering committee formed the following year. After building Australia's first public VHF translator, the station began official broadcasting on 9 September 1983 and continues to serve the Bellingen Shire.

2bobradio.org.au.name: 2BOB Radio
2bobradio.org.au.about: 2BOB Radio is a volunteer-run community radio station in Taree, in the Manning Valley on the NSW Mid North Coast, broadcasting on 104.7 FM. Established in the mid-1980s, its name stands for "Broadcasting on (a) Budget," and it is known for showcasing diverse, new Australian music.

2bs.com.au.name: 2BS
2bs.com.au.about: 2BS is a commercial radio station serving the Central Tablelands of NSW from Bathurst, first broadcasting on 1 January 1937. Long operated by local proprietors Ron and Stephanie Camplin, it was sold to the Broadcast Operations Group in 2019 and now airs a news-talk and classic hits format on 95.1 FM.

2ca.com.au.name: 2CA
2ca.com.au.about: 2CA was Canberra's first radio station, commencing broadcasts on 14 November 1931 under a licence held by Jack Ryan. Now jointly owned by Capital Radio Network and Grant Broadcasters, it broadcasts a "Forever Classic" hits format on 1053 AM.

2chr.org.name: 2CHR (Central Hunter Radio)
2chr.org.about: 2CHR is a volunteer-run community radio station serving the Central Hunter area of NSW from studios at the Cessnock School of Arts. It was formed in 2000 through the merger of two aspirant community broadcasters, Cessnock Community Radio and Radio Maitland, and broadcasts on 96.5 FM.

2cr.com.au.name: 2CR Australian Chinese Radio
2cr.com.au.about: 2CR (澳洲中文廣播電台) is an Australian Chinese-language radio station broadcasting Cantonese and Mandarin programming, including news, lifestyle, health and cultural content, and marked around three decades on air as of the mid-2020s. It is distinct from the ABC's historical "2CR" callsign used for its Central West NSW service.

2dryfm.com.name: 2DRY FM
2dryfm.com.about: 2DRY FM is the community radio station for Broken Hill and Menindee, established in 1989 as the area's first local FM station. It broadcasts local news, culture and issues affecting the community, with a strong role in Indigenous programming for the region.

2ec.com.au.name: 2EC
2ec.com.au.about: 2EC is a commercial radio station broadcasting to the Eurobodalla and Bega Valley areas of the NSW South Coast, tracing its roots to sister station 2BE which began test broadcasts in 1937. Formerly part of Grant Broadcasters, 2EC was acquired by ARN in a deal finalised in January 2022 and airs a classic hits format on 94.5/105.5/105.9 FM.

2ghr.org.au.name: 2GHR Greater Hume Radio
2ghr.org.au.about: 2GHR (Greater Hume Radio) is a community radio station broadcasting 24/7 on 96.7 FM from a studio near Ten Mile Creek, serving the Greater Hume Shire in southern NSW between Albury-Wodonga and Wagga Wagga.

2hayfm.com.au.name: 2 Hay FM
2hayfm.com.au.about: 2 Hay FM is a locally run and operated community radio station serving the Hay Shire in southwestern NSW on 92.1 FM.

2lt.com.au.name: 2LT
2lt.com.au.about: 2LT is a commercial radio station established by Lithgow Broadcasters Pty Ltd, opening in July 1939. It was part of Macquarie's Central Western Network for much of its history and became the first regional Australian station to win multiple national broadcast awards in 1980; it now broadcasts a classic hits format on 900 AM.

2maxfm.com.au.name: 2Max FM
2maxfm.com.au.about: 2Max FM is the community radio station of Narrabri Shire Community Radio Inc, founded in March 1993 following public meetings, with test broadcasts starting later that year. It received a full-time licence in 2000 and broadcasts on 91.3 FM to Narrabri, Wee Waa, Coonabarabran, Gunnedah and Moree.

2mbsfinemusicsydney.com.name: 2MBS Fine Music Sydney
2mbsfinemusicsydney.com.about: 2MBS Fine Music Sydney is Australia's first fully licensed FM radio station, launched on 15 December 1974 by a group of volunteer music enthusiasts. Owned by the Music Broadcasting Society of NSW Co-operative, it broadcasts classical, jazz, blues, world and folk music on 102.5 FM and is run by around 200 volunteers.

2mce.org.name: 2MCE Community Radio
2mce.org.about: 2MCE is Charles Sturt University's community radio station, operated in partnership with the Bathurst and Orange communities. It began full-time broadcasting in May 1976 and is one of Australia's oldest non-metropolitan licensed community stations, with alumni including Andrew Denton and Amanda Keller; it broadcasts on 92.3 FM in Bathurst and 94.7 FM in Orange.

2mcr.org.au.name: 2MCR (Macarthur Community Radio)
2mcr.org.au.about: 2MCR-FM is a community radio station covering Campbelltown, Camden and the Wollondilly Shire in Sydney's south-west. It grew out of Macarthur Community Radio, which held its first public meeting in August 1989 and initially broadcast for limited periods before opening permanent studios, "Radio House," in Ingleburn in 1993; it now broadcasts on 100.3 FM.

2miafm.org.au.name: 2MIA FM
2miafm.org.au.about: 2MIA FM is a not-for-profit community radio station serving the Murrumbidgee Irrigation Area around Griffith, NSW. The Griffith Community FM Association began organising in January 1988 and the station has broadcast full-time since 1993, with multicultural programming reflecting the district's diverse population, on 95.1 FM.

2mno.org.au.name: 2MNO Monaro FM
2mno.org.au.about: 2MNO Monaro FM is a volunteer-run, not-for-profit community radio station serving the Monaro and Snowy Mountains region of NSW from studios in Cooma and Nimmitabel, broadcasting since the mid-to-late 1990s on 90.5 FM.

2ncr.org.au.name: 2NCR River FM
2ncr.org.au.about: 2NCR is one of the earliest licensed non-metropolitan FM community stations in NSW, broadcasting from Lismore since 1976. Originally licensed to the Northern Rivers College of Advanced Education, it passed to a dedicated community association (North Coast Radio Inc) when the college became part of Southern Cross University, and is now branded 92.9 River FM.

2nm.com.au.name: 2NM
2nm.com.au.about: 2NM is a commercial radio station licensed to Muswellbrook in the NSW Hunter Valley, launched on 14 November 1954. Acquired by the Australian Radio Network in 2021 as part of the Grant Broadcasters portfolio, it broadcasts a classic hits, adult contemporary, talk and sport format on 981 AM.

2nurfm.com.au.name: 2NURFM
2nurfm.com.au.about: 2NURFM began broadcasting from the University of Newcastle on 17 March 1978, making it the Hunter region's first FM and first community radio station. The University of Newcastle continues to hold the licence, with the station funded by listener donations and sponsorship and staffed by volunteers and students on 103.7 FM.

2nvr.org.au.name: 2NVR Nambucca Valley Radio
2nvr.org.au.about: 2NVR Nambucca Valley Radio is a volunteer-run community station broadcasting from Tewinga on 105.9 FM, offering music, news, sport, talk and comedy for the Nambucca Valley. Its local current-affairs program has been a national CBAA Awards finalist.

2oceansfm.com.au.name: 2 Oceans FM
2oceansfm.com.au.about: 2 Oceans FM is a volunteer-run community radio station based in Augusta, Western Australia, broadcasting on 97.1 FM. After a lengthy campaign for a frequency, ACMA allocated 97.1 MHz in April 2008 and, with support from Lotterywest and the Southwest Development Commission, the station began broadcasting in 2009.

2qn.com.au.name: 2QN
2qn.com.au.about: 2QN, "The Riverina Station," traces its origins to 1934 as 2DN before becoming a commercial licence as 2QN in November 1935. Now owned by ACE Radio, it broadcasts a classic hits and sport-heavy talk format on 1521 AM to the Deniliquin area.

2rem1073fm.com.au.name: Radio 2REM
2rem1073fm.com.au.about: Radio 2REM is a community radio station serving Albury-Wodonga, run by the Community Radio Albury Wodonga Cooperative Society. It grew out of a 1977 feasibility study into public broadcasting for the region and marked its 40th anniversary in 2020, now broadcasting on 107.3 FM.

2sea.com.au.name: 2SEA Southern Community Radio
2sea.com.au.about: 2SEA is a not-for-profit community radio station established in 1995 and licensed in 2000, serving Eden, Pambula and Merimbula on the NSW Sapphire Coast. It relies on over 20 volunteer presenters and 150 associate members, broadcasting local and syndicated content on 104.7 FM.

2sm.com.au.name: 2SM
2sm.com.au.about: 2SM is a commercial radio station opened by Archbishop Michael Kelly on 24 December 1931 after Father James Meany raised funds to form the Catholic Broadcasting Company; its name honours St Mark's parish in Drummoyne. Long promoted as "The Family Station," 2SM is today part of the Super Radio Network.

2ssr.com.au.name: 2SSR-FM
2ssr.com.au.about: 2SSR-FM is the Sutherland Shire's volunteer-run community radio station, founded by ten local members and granted a permanent licence in 1991, commencing regular broadcasting on 26 September 1992. Sutherland Shire Council was a founding sponsor, and the station broadcasts on 99.7 FM with a minimum of 30% Australian content.

2st.com.au.name: 2ST
2st.com.au.about: 2ST is a commercial radio station that began broadcasting in 1972 to the Shoalhaven and Southern Tablelands of NSW, with its callsign reflecting the "South Coast and Tablelands" coverage area. Acquired by the Australian Radio Network in a 2021-22 deal, it switched off its AM transmitter in 2021 and now broadcasts on FM repeaters including 91.7 MHz Nowra.

2ue.com.au.name: 2UE
2ue.com.au.about: 2UE first went to air on 26 January 1925, making it Australia's oldest commercial radio station. It was founded by Cecil "Pa" Stevenson of Electrical Utilities, broadcasting initially from his Maroubra home, and remains a long-running Sydney talk station on 954 AM.

2wayfm.com.au.name: 2WAY FM
2wayfm.com.au.about: 2WAY FM is a community radio station covering the Hastings Valley/Greater Port Macquarie area of the NSW Mid North Coast, with roots in test transmissions from a solar-powered caravan at Pappinbarra around 1986. It became Australia's 100th permanently licensed community station in 1992 and now broadcasts from Wauchope on 103.9 FM.

2wcrfm.org.au.name: 2WCR-FM Warrumbungle Community Radio
2wcrfm.org.au.about: 2WCR-FM is Coonabarabran and the Warrumbungle Shire's volunteer-run community radio station, with a broadcasting licence commencing in December 2004. It reaches towns across the Warrumbungles, Pilliga Forest and Siding Spring area on 99.5 FM.

2xl.com.au.name: XLFM
2xl.com.au.about: XLFM, originally 2XL, is a commercial radio station in Cooma that opened in August 1937, serving the Snowy Mountains region. It converted from AM to FM in 2019 and rebranded from 2XL to XLFM, and is now owned by Capital Radio Network as the hub of its regional "Forever Classic" network.

2yyyradio.com.name: 2YYY Radio
2yyyradio.com.about: 2YYY is a community radio station in Young, NSW, formed by local residents led by former 2LF/Star FM manager Graham McDonald and beginning broadcasting in September 2004. It operates on 92.3 FM with a fully volunteer roster of presenters.

3abnaustralia.org.au.name: 3ABN Australia Radio
3abnaustralia.org.au.about: 3ABN Australia Radio is the Australian outlet of the Three Angels Broadcasting Network, an American Seventh-day Adventist Christian media network founded in 1984 by Danny and Linda Shelton. It broadcasts religious, health and lifestyle programming to Australian listeners.

3aw.com.au.name: 3AW
3aw.com.au.about: 3AW is a long-running Melbourne commercial talk radio station broadcasting on 693 AM, historically one of the city's dominant news-talk broadcasters. It is owned by Nine Radio (formerly Macquarie Media/Fairfax) and remains one of Australia's most-listened-to talk stations.

3ba.com.au.name: 3BA
3ba.com.au.about: 3BA is a commercial radio station in Ballarat that received its commercial licence on 31 July 1930. It moved from AM to FM (102.3 MHz) in 1998, and was acquired by the Australian Radio Network in a 2021-22 deal covering the former Grant Broadcasters network.

3bbrfm.org.au.name: 3BBR-FM
3bbrfm.org.au.about: 3BBR-FM ("Baw Baw Radio") is West Gippsland Community Radio's station, first broadcasting on 13 May 1995 with monthly then weekly programs before moving to a full seven-day schedule by 1998 and 24-hour broadcasting from 2000. It serves Drouin, Warragul, Pakenham, Moe and Korumburra on 103.1 FM.

3cs.com.au.name: 3CS
3cs.com.au.about: 3CS is a commercial radio station in Colac, Victoria, first broadcasting on 9 October 1939 after local businessmen formed the Colac Broadcasting Company. ACE Radio acquired 3CS in 1985, and it now airs a classic hits, talk, sport and news format on 1134 AM aimed at listeners aged 35-60.

3gg.com.au.name: 3GG
3gg.com.au.about: 3GG began in 1937 as 3UL in Warragul, founded by Vic Dinenny, and was renamed 3GG ("Greater Gippsland") in November 1989 after studios moved to Traralgon. Owned by Capital Radio Network since 2015, it broadcasts across Gippsland and the Latrobe Valley on 531 AM.

3ha.com.au.name: 3HA
3ha.com.au.about: 3HA is a commercial radio station in Hamilton, Victoria, with a history dating to 1931; its powerful transmitter on Mount Bainbridge covers western Victoria, the Wimmera and south-east South Australia. Its 1984 acquisition by Associated Communication Enterprises founded what became the ACE Radio network, which still owns the station.

3mgb.org.au.name: 3MGB Wilderness Radio
3mgb.org.au.about: 3MGB Wilderness Radio is a volunteer-run community station for Mallacoota and Genoa in remote Far East Gippsland, established after a 1983 bushfire exposed the town's lack of emergency communications. Licensed since the mid-1990s, it served as an emergency broadcaster during the 2019-20 Black Summer bushfires and airs on 101.7/96.9 FM.

3mp.com.au.name: 3MP
3mp.com.au.about: 3MP began transmission on 22 July 1976 from the Bayside Shopping Centre in Frankston, becoming the first commercial radio station based in Melbourne's outer suburbs; its callsign reflects the Mornington Peninsula. Now owned by ACE Radio, it broadcasts an easy-listening format on 1377 AM and DAB+.

3ne.com.au.name: 3NE
3ne.com.au.about: 3NE was a commercial radio station in Wangaratta, Victoria, opened on 27 March 1954 and owned by ACE Radio from 2017. As part of the ACMA's AM-to-FM conversion program, the station relaunched on 92.1 FM as Star FM in mid-2025, ending over 70 years of 3NE branding on 1566 AM.

3sh.com.au.name: 3SH
3sh.com.au.about: 3SH, "the Mallee's Heritage Station," opened in Swan Hill on 27 August 1931 and has been owned by ACE Radio since the mid-1980s. It broadcasts classic hits and talk on 1332 AM alongside its FM sister station Mixx FM.

3wbc.org.au.name: 3WBC
3wbc.org.au.about: 3WBC is a volunteer-run community radio station for Melbourne's inner-eastern Whitehorse and Boroondara municipalities, formed after a decade of test broadcasts and lobbying and reaching full-time transmission in September 2001. It has broadcast from Box Hill Town Hall since 2007 on 94.1 FM.

3wm.com.au.name: 3WM
3wm.com.au.about: 3WM traces its history to 3HS, which opened in Horsham on 11 September 1933 before passing through several ownership and callsign changes. Now part of the ACE Radio network, it serves the Wimmera-Mallee region on 1089 AM with FM repeaters at Ararat and Nhill.

3ybfm.com.au.name: 3YB FM
3ybfm.com.au.about: 3YB FM has an unusual history, starting in 1931 as a mobile radio station founded by Jack Young of Ballarat that toured Victorian towns before settling permanently in Warrnambool in 1935-36. Part of the ACE Radio network, it moved from AM to 94.5 FM in 2018 and continues to serve Warrnambool and the Great South Coast.

3zzz.com.au.name: 3ZZZ
3zzz.com.au.about: 3ZZZ is Australia's largest multicultural community radio station, broadcasting in Melbourne on 92.3 FM since June 1989. It grew out of the earlier ABC-run experimental ethnic-access station 3ZZ, following campaigning by George Zangalis, and today represents over 50 community groups across around 60 languages.

4bc.com.au.name: 4BC
4bc.com.au.about: 4BC was established on 16 August 1930 by electrical retailer and future Brisbane Lord Mayor John Beals Chandler, becoming Queensland's first commercial radio station. It broadcasts on 882 AM as Brisbane's only commercial talkback station, currently owned by Tapt Media.

4bh.com.au.name: 4BH
4bh.com.au.about: 4BH opened on 2 January 1932 as Brisbane's third commercial station, also founded by John Beals Chandler, with its callsign derived from the Bald Hills transmitter site. It has operated on 1116 AM through numerous ownership changes over more than nine decades.

4bu.com.au.name: 4BU
4bu.com.au.about: 4BU is a commercial radio station in Bundaberg that began broadcasting on 16 December 1935 after Bundaberg Broadcasters Pty Ltd was formed earlier that year. Now owned by the Australian Radio Network, it plays a classic hits format with local programming from its Maryborough Street studios.

4ca.com.au.name: 4CA
4ca.com.au.about: 4CA was Cairns's first commercial AM radio station, launched in May 1936 on 1470 kHz before settling on 846 kHz. It has since converted to FM as 4CAFM on 102.7 MHz, with a translator in Gordonvale.

4cc.com.au.name: 4CC
4cc.com.au.about: 4CC began broadcasting to Gladstone and Rockhampton on 17 August 1970 under the callsign 4CD, renamed 4CC after a 1985 sale to Wesgo. It is a classic hits commercial station on 927 AM, with repeaters serving Biloela, Agnes Water and Rockhampton.

4k1g.org.name: 4K1G
4k1g.org.about: 4K1G is an Indigenous Australian community radio station in Townsville, established in 1972 to promote and broadcast Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander news, music and views. Owned by the Townsville Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Corporation for Media, it broadcasts on 107.1 FM with a 16 kW transmitter.

4mk.com.au.name: 4MK
4mk.com.au.about: 4MK was Queensland's first commercial radio station established outside the south-east, built and operated from 1931 by amateur wireless enthusiast Jack Williams and his father from their family home in Mackay. Now owned by ARN, it broadcasts a classic hits format on 1026 AM.

4rfm.com.au.name: 4RFM
4rfm.com.au.about: 4RFM is a community radio station in Moranbah, Queensland, founded in 1998 as a youth-focused project (originally "87.6 Rock FM") before broadening its appeal and gaining a permanent licence with support from local mining employers. It is owned by Rock FM Association Inc and broadcasts to the Central Highlands on 96.9 FM.

4ro.com.au.name: 4RO
4ro.com.au.about: 4RO was Rockhampton's first commercial radio station, launched on 2 July 1932. It remains an AM broadcaster on 990 kHz for Central Queensland, with a talk and classic hits format.

4you.org.au.name: Community Radio 4YOU
4you.org.au.about: Community Radio 4YOU is a volunteer-run station managed by Capricorn Community Radio Inc (originally the Capricorn Community Christian Broadcasting Society), broadcasting to a 100km radius around Rockhampton on 98.5 FM since its first broadcast in 1989.

5-thefm.org.name: 5THEfm
5-thefm.org.about: 5THEfm is a community radio station serving Millicent and the surrounding South-East South Australian towns of Beachport, Kingston SE, Mount Gambier, Naracoorte and Robe. A steering committee formed in 1986, with the first test transmission in 1987 and full broadcasting beginning on 1 July 1993; the station briefly lost its licence in 2022 before returning to air in 2023.

5ebi.com.au.name: 5EBI
5ebi.com.au.about: 5EBI is South Australia's only dedicated ethnic community radio station, established in the 1970s and celebrating its 50th anniversary in March 2025. Run by over 200 volunteers, it broadcasts in more than 40 languages on 103.1 FM to serve the state's non-English-speaking communities.

5gtr.net.name: 5GTR FM
5gtr.net.about: 5GTR FM is a community radio station based in Mount Gambier, South Australia, founded in 1983. It began at Odeon Plaza before relocating to its present premises, and broadcasts on 100.1 FM in partnership with SACBA and the CBAA.

5mbs.com.name: 5MBS
5mbs.com.about: 5MBS, operated by the Music Broadcasting Society of SA, is a listener-funded fine music community station established in 1993. It broadcasts classical, jazz, blues and world music to Adelaide on 99.9 FM as an independent, grassroots organisation.

5triplez.com.au.name: 5 Triple Z
5triplez.com.au.about: 5 Triple Z is a volunteer-run community radio station based at the McLaren Vale RSL on South Australia's Fleurieu Peninsula, governed by Southern Vales Community Radio Inc. It emphasises local content and promotes emerging regional musicians across a diverse range of music genres.

6ix.com.au.name: 6IX
6ix.com.au.about: 6IX was opened on 27 November 1933 by John Kirwan, then President of the WA Legislative Council. After passing through numerous owners including TVW, the Bell Group and Austereo, it has been a joint venture of Capital Radio Network and Grant Broadcasters since 1998, broadcasting classic hits on 1080 AM.

6pr.com.au.name: 6PR
6pr.com.au.about: 6PR commenced broadcasting on 14 October 1931, established by electrical retailer Nicholson's Limited. Now owned by Tapt Media, it is Perth's only commercial talkback station, broadcasting news, talk, sport and traffic on 882 AM.

7hofm.com.au.name: 7HOFM
7hofm.com.au.about: 7HOFM traces its history to 13 August 1930, when it began as Hobart's first commercial radio station on AM. It converted to FM (101.7 MHz) in 1990 and adopted its current identity in 2007; it is now owned by the Australian Radio Network and plays an adult contemporary format.

7rph.org.au.name: 7RPH (Print Radio Tasmania)
7rph.org.au.about: 7RPH, Print Radio Tasmania, began daily programming on 26 June 1982 from New Town, Hobart, becoming the first Radio for the Print Handicapped (RPH) station in Australia. It provides live readings of newspapers and magazines and serialised books for people who are unable to read or access print media easily, with transmitters later added in Launceston and Devonport.

885fm.com.au.name: 88.5 FM
885fm.com.au.about: 88.5 FM ("Where Variety Comes Alive") is a volunteer-run community radio station serving the City of Swan area in the Perth metropolitan region, offering over 140 hours a week of varied programming across genres including R&B, progressive rock and underground music.

889fmtamworth.com.au.name: 88.9 FM
889fmtamworth.com.au.about: 88.9 FM began in 1983 as Tamworth Broadcast Services and later operated as 2YOUFM before rebranding to 88.9 FM in 2014. Describing itself as Australia's largest regional community radio station, it serves New England, the North West and the Liverpool Plains with a mix of decades-spanning hits and country music.

893fm.com.au.name: 89.3 2GLF
893fm.com.au.about: 89.3 2GLF is a community radio station for Sydney's Liverpool-Fairfield area, run by the Liverpool-Fairfield Community Radio Co-operative. It grew out of 1970s community activism in the Green Valley housing estate and began regular broadcasting on 89.3 FM in September 1983, today airing programs for numerous local ethnic communities including Maltese, Slovenian and Mandaean groups.

897fm.com.au.name: 89.7FM
897fm.com.au.about: 89.7FM ("The People The Music") is a community radio station based at Edith Cowan University's Joondalup campus, serving the northern Perth suburbs with support from the Cities of Joondalup, Wanneroo and Stirling.

8ccc.com.au.name: 8CCC
8ccc.com.au.about: 8CCC is an outback community radio station established in 1981 to serve the Alice Springs and Tennant Creek communities with locally relevant programming, amplifying community and multicultural voices not covered by commercial broadcasters. It broadcasts on 102.1 FM.

901nbcfm.com.au.name: 90.1 NBC FM
901nbcfm.com.au.about: 90.1 NBC FM is a community radio station broadcasting 24/7 to Sydney's Narwee/Bayside area, offering music from the 1960s to today alongside programs in Mandarin, Macedonian, Cantonese, Greek, Spanish, French and Nepali for the area's multicultural community.

911hotfm.com.au.name: 91.1 Hot FM
911hotfm.com.au.about: 91.1 Hot FM began broadcasting on 27 October 2003 as the Sunshine Coast's third commercial radio station. Now owned by the Australian Radio Network, it airs a contemporary hit radio format.

917thewave.com.au.name: 91.7 The Wave
917thewave.com.au.about: 91.7 The Wave is a community radio station serving the Peel region around Mandurah, Western Australia, providing local music, news, entertainment and community event coverage for the area.

919seafm.com.au.name: 91.9 Sea FM
919seafm.com.au.about: 91.9 Sea FM launched on 26 June 1996 as the Sunshine Coast's second commercial FM station, modelled on its Gold Coast sister station. After changing hands several times, including sale to Southern Cross Austereo and then EON Broadcasting in 2013, it is now owned by Great Southern Land Media Group and plays a Top 40 format.

923.com.au.name: 92.3FM 4TVR
923.com.au.about: 92.3FM (4TVR) is a community radio station serving Mareeba and the Atherton Tablelands region of Far North Queensland.

941fm.com.au.name: 94.1FM
941fm.com.au.about: 94.1FM is a community radio station on the Gold Coast targeting listeners aged 50 and over, with a format mixing 1980s music, classic hits and current tracks. Broadcasting at 5kW from Tamborine Mountain, it reaches from southern Brisbane to the Tweed Coast from studios at Mermaid Beach.

943.com.au.name: Dubbo's 94.3
943.com.au.about: Dubbo's 94.3 is a listener-funded Christian community radio station operated by Dubbo Christian Broadcasters Inc, serving Dubbo, NSW and the surrounding region with gospel-focused music and talk programming.

949powerfm.com.au.name: 94.9 Power FM
949powerfm.com.au.about: 94.9 Power FM is a commercial radio station serving the South Coast and Southern Tablelands of NSW from Nowra, launched in the late 1980s as an FM supplementary licence alongside sister station 2ST. It is now part of the Australian Radio Network.

951gemfm.org.name: 95.1 GEM FM
951gemfm.org.about: 95.1 GEM FM is a not-for-profit, volunteer-run community radio station based at the TAFE building in Bowen, Queensland, broadcasting local news, indigenous content, arts and culture programming to the Whitsunday region.

96five.com.name: 96five (Rise 96.5)
96five.com.about: 96five, now branded Rise 96.5, is a Christian community radio station in Brisbane that began broadcasting on 1 November 2001. Operated by the non-profit Family Radio Ltd from studios in Taringa, it plays family-friendly contemporary Christian and mainstream music with no profanity.

96fm.com.au.name: Gold 96FM
96fm.com.au.about: 96FM began broadcasting on 8 August 1980 as Perth's first commercial FM radio station, later pioneering innovations such as Australia's first on-air CD playback in 1982. Now owned by ARN Media and rebranded Gold 96FM, it plays an adult contemporary format on 96.1 FM.

96three.com.au.name: 96three FM
96three.com.au.about: 96three FM is a Christian community radio station serving Geelong and surrounding areas including Melbourne, first broadcasting on 1 September 1994 under the earlier name Rhema Geelong. It is run by Geelong Christian Media Inc from studios in Grovedale, on 96.3 FM.

973fm.com.au.name: KIIS 973
973fm.com.au.about: KIIS 973 (formerly branded 97.3FM) is a Brisbane commercial radio station that launched on 26 September 2001, owned as a 50/50 joint venture between ARN and Nova Entertainment. It rebranded from 97.3FM to the KIIS network name in January 2022, airing a contemporary hit radio format aimed at 25-54 year olds.

979fm.com.au.name: 979fm
979fm.com.au.about: 979fm (call sign 3RIM) is a volunteer-run community radio station broadcasting on 97.9 FM to Melton and Melbourne's west. Incorporated in 1985 after a local steering committee began investigating a community station in 1980, it is one of Victoria's older community broadcasters, airing hit music, variety and multicultural programming from studios at Victoria University's Melton South campus.

981powerfm.com.au.name: Power FM 98.1
981powerfm.com.au.about: Power FM 98.1 (call sign 2VLY) is a commercial radio station serving Muswellbrook and the Upper Hunter Valley of NSW, including Singleton, Scone and Aberdeen. Owned by ARN and operated by Radio Hunter Valley alongside sister station 2NM, it began broadcasting on 7 June 1995 with an adult contemporary format.

989warfm.com.au.name: 2WAR FM
989warfm.com.au.about: 2WAR FM is a volunteer-run community radio station based in Gilgandra, NSW, broadcasting on 98.9 FM. It began in 1999 from a small former bakery shop before moving into its own premises, a former Telecom building, in 2003.

997fm.com.au.name: 99.7 Bridge FM
997fm.com.au.about: 99.7 Bridge FM (call sign 4RED) is a volunteer-run community radio station broadcasting a classic rock format to Brisbane's northern suburbs and the City of Moreton Bay from studios in Redcliffe. Run entirely by volunteers since 1992, it became the first Australian community broadcaster to install a full digital air chain, in 2006/2007.

abcjazz.net.au.name: ABC Jazz
abcjazz.net.au.about: ABC Jazz is a national digital radio station operated by the Australian Broadcasting Corporation, dedicated to jazz music around the clock. It grew out of the online service Dig Jazz launched in 2004 and relaunched under its current name on 1 July 2009, and is available on DAB+ digital radio, digital TV and online.

albayan.com.au.name: Albayan Radio
albayan.com.au.about: Albayan Radio is an Islamic community radio station based in Belmore, Sydney, broadcasting Arabic and English-language religious and cultural programming in line with the Quran and Sunnah. Positioned as the voice of Ahlus Sunnah Wal Jama'ah (ASWJ) Australia, it airs lectures and talks covering Islamic creed, jurisprudence, history, and youth, health and community topics.

alive905.com.au.name: Alive 90.5
alive905.com.au.about: Alive 90.5 (call sign 2CCR) is a volunteer-run community radio station serving Sydney's Parramatta, Cumberland and Hills districts from studios in Baulkham Hills. Broadcasting since 1992 - originally as Cumberland Community Radio, later on-air as '2CCR' - it adopted the Alive 90.5 name in November 2011 and airs adult contemporary, jazz, country and easy listening alongside programs for special interest and language groups.

allaussieradio.com.au.name: All Aussie Radio
allaussieradio.com.au.about: All Aussie Radio is a small Australian internet radio operation run by Phill and Lyn, broadcasting travel and country-music programs such as Roamin' Oz and Corner Country as they tour Australia by caravan, operating from a postal address in Harrington, NSW rather than a licensed terrestrial signal.

allhitoldies.com.name: Allhitoldies
allhitoldies.com.about: Allhitoldies is a small, independently run Australian internet radio station based in Warrnambool, Victoria, streaming hits, oldies, pop and classic rock from the 1950s-1970s under the tagline "Keeping the Memories Alive".

alltimeradio.com.au.name: All Time Hits Radio
alltimeradio.com.au.about: All Time Hits Radio is a Melbourne-based Australian internet radio operation running a family of themed streams - including a general hits channel and offshoots such as All Time Hits Radio Worship (Christian worship music), Throwbacks, Opera, Kids and Christmas - rather than a single licensed broadcast station.

alpinefm.org.au.name: Alpine FM
alpinefm.org.au.about: Alpine FM is a volunteer-run community radio station based in Mount Beauty in north-east Victoria, broadcasting to the Upper Kiewa Valley on 96.5 FM and, since 2011, the Ovens Valley on 92.9 FM. It was incorporated as the Kiewa Valley Community Radio Association in November 2001 and began broadcasting in August 2003, and is a recognised Official Emergency Services Broadcaster.

anandamarga.org.au.name: Ananda Marga Kiirtan
anandamarga.org.au.about: Ananda Marga Kiirtan is an online radio stream operated by the Ananda Marga meditation, yoga and social service organisation in Australia, broadcasting continuous devotional kiirtan chanting (the Baba Nam Kevalam mantra) rather than conventional talk or music programming.

andrewhaug.com.name: AndrewHaug.com Metal Radio
andrewhaug.com.about: AndrewHaug.com is billed as Australia's first and only 24/7 metal radio station, run by Melbourne broadcaster and musician Andrew Haug, best known for hosting the heavy metal program Full Metal Racket on Triple J from 2001 to 2011 and earlier on community station 3RRR. Haug has also gone on to co-found the Riff Crew heavy-music media outlet.

apple985fm.com.au.name: Apple FM
apple985fm.com.au.about: Apple FM (call sign 3APL) is a volunteer-run community radio station licensed to Bacchus Marsh, Victoria, broadcasting on 98.5 FM. It received its full broadcasting licence in 2001 and airs a wide range of music genres alongside ethnic and religious programs and live commentary of local Ballarat League football matches.

artsound.fm.name: ArtSound FM
artsound.fm.about: ArtSound FM (call sign 1ART) is a volunteer-run community radio station in Canberra dedicated to fine music and the arts - jazz, classical, blues, folk and world music. It traces its origins to 1983 as Canberra Stereo Public Radio and broadcasts on 92.7 FM from studios in Manuka, supported by the ACT Government and the Community Broadcasting Foundation.

aspradio.au.name: ASP Radio
aspradio.au.about: ASP Radio is a small Australian internet radio stream based in Victoria, hosted on the AzuraCast streaming platform. Little independent information is available about its ownership, format or history.

auscountry.com.au.name: Australian Country Radio
auscountry.com.au.about: Australian Country Radio is an internet-only station describing itself as "Australia's Home of Country Music", streaming country programming including the John Nutting-hosted Australian Country show via apps such as TuneIn and Alexa rather than a terrestrial FM licence.

ausopen.com.name: AO Radio
ausopen.com.about: AO Radio is the official radio broadcast of the Australian Open tennis tournament, produced by Tennis Australia and broadcast on 99.7FM in Melbourne alongside partners including Vision Australia Radio, the SEN network, iHeartRadio and, internationally, ESPN via Sirius XM, providing live match commentary during the annual tournament.

bay939.com.au.name: Bay 93.9
bay939.com.au.about: Bay 93.9 (call sign 3BAY) is a commercial FM radio station based in Geelong, Victoria, branded "Geelong's Feeling Good" station. It has broadcast since 1989 and is owned and operated by Geelong Broadcasters Pty Ltd.

bayfm.org.au.name: Bay FM
bayfm.org.au.about: Bay FM is a volunteer-run community radio station established in 1993, serving the Redland City (Bay Islands/Thornlands) area of south-east Queensland on 100.3 FM. Originally focused on classic rock, it now airs more than 25 locally produced shows across a range of genres and streams internationally via iHeartRadio.

bbbfm.com.name: BBBfm
bbbfm.com.about: BBBfm 89.1 is a volunteer-run community radio station serving the Barossa Valley region of South Australia and a member of the Community Broadcasting Association of Australia. It features locally produced music shows, podcasts and radio plays that highlight South Australian artists.

bbm987.com.au.name: Bumma Bippera Media
bbm987.com.au.about: Bumma Bippera Media (98.7 FM) is Gimuy/Cairns' first and only Indigenous community radio service, broadcasting to Cairns and surrounding areas including Gordonvale, Kuranda, Atherton, Mareeba and Yarrabah. It combines local music and talk with the nationally syndicated weekday program Talk Black, and is run by a mix of Indigenous and non-Indigenous staff and volunteers.

bdcu.org.au.name: World Buddhist Radio
bdcu.org.au.about: World Buddhist Radio is an online radio stream operated by the Buddhist Discussion Centre (Upwey) Ltd in Victoria, broadcasting dharma teachings, scripture readings, chanting and Buddhist music aimed at building tolerance and harmony between people of different cultures and faiths.

binjangradio.net.name: Binjang Community Radio
binjangradio.net.about: Binjang Community Radio is a small community radio station broadcasting on 87.8 FM to Wellington, New South Wales, listed among Australia's registered community broadcasters.

bitwaves.com.au.name: BitWaves
bitwaves.com.au.about: BitWaves is an independent online radio station based in South Australia, streaming 1990s and 2000s music to Adelaide and regional communities including Gawler, Mount Gambier, Whyalla and Port Augusta, alongside South Australian news and community updates.

bondiradio.com.au.name: Bondi Radio
bondiradio.com.au.about: Bondi Radio bills itself as "Australia's Electronic Heartbeat", an online radio station based in Sydney specialising in electronic dance music, with live shows and an archive distributed across multiple social platforms.

braidwoodradio.com.au.name: Braidwood Radio
braidwoodradio.com.au.about: Braidwood Radio is a community radio station broadcasting on 88.9 FM from Braidwood, New South Wales, run by a station manager and volunteer committee. It airs a wide range of music genres plus talk, news and podcast content, and acknowledges the area's Indigenous Traditional Owners.

brockfm.com.au.name: B-Rock FM
brockfm.com.au.about: B-Rock FM is a local commercial radio station on 99.3 FM (call sign 2BXS) broadcasting to Bathurst, New South Wales.

c2cra.online.name: Coast 2 Coast Radio Australia
c2cra.online.about: Coast 2 Coast Radio Australia is a small Australian online radio station featuring a roster of DJs, accessible via dedicated Android and iOS apps rather than a terrestrial broadcast licence.

c913.com.au.name: C91.3
c913.com.au.about: C91.3 is a community radio station serving the Macarthur region of south-western Sydney, branded "Macarthur's Radio Station", with local breakfast, daytime and drive programs plus community competitions and events.

cada.com.au.name: CADA
cada.com.au.about: CADA (call sign 2ONE, 96.1 FM) is a commercial radio station operated by ARN Media and licensed to Katoomba, NSW, though its signal covers much of the Sydney basin. Its licence dates back to 2KA in 1935; it became FM station One/96.1FM in 1990, was rebranded The Edge 96.ONE in 2002, and relaunched as CADA - "Australia's home of hip hop and R&B" - on 31 March 2022.

cairnsfm891.org.au.name: Cairns FM 89.1
cairnsfm891.org.au.about: Cairns FM 89.1 is a not-for-profit multicultural community radio station that began broadcasting in February 1985 after five years of advocacy by the Cairns FM Broadcasting Society, making it Cairns' first FM station. It devotes around 30 hours a week to Indigenous and multicultural programming alongside local breakfast programming, news and music.

capitalcommunityradio.com.name: Capital Community Radio
capitalcommunityradio.com.about: Capital Community Radio (101.7 FM) is a volunteer-run community radio station in Perth, Western Australia, playing music from the 1940s to 1980s alongside local community information.

caseyradio.com.au.name: Casey Radio
caseyradio.com.au.about: Casey Radio (97.7 FM) is a volunteer-run community radio station serving Melbourne's south-eastern suburbs on the traditional lands of the Boon Wurrung people, broadcasting local news, sport (including VFL/VFLW coverage) and a broad mix of music.

centralcoastradio.com.name: Central Coast Radio
centralcoastradio.com.about: Central Coast Radio is an internet radio station, operated by Coast Radio Australia Pty Ltd as part of a small international "Coast" radio group with sister stations in the UK, France and Spain, serving the NSW Central Coast area from Port Macquarie to Newcastle and the Hawkesbury with more than 35 volunteer-produced shows streamed from presenters' home studios.

chillifm.com.au.name: Chilli FM
chillifm.com.au.about: Chilli FM (90.1 FM) is a commercial radio station based in Launceston, Tasmania, operated by Bass Radio Pty Limited, airing networked programs such as Nic & Marcus for Breakfast and Will & Woody alongside local news and community content.

cityparkradio.com.name: City Park Radio
cityparkradio.com.about: City Park Radio is a non-profit community radio station owned and run by the Launceston Community FM Group, established in 1978 and incorporated in 1982. It began broadcasting as 7LTN-FM on 7 April 1986, moved to City Park Cottage and adopted its current name in 1988, and today broadcasts on 103.7 and 96.5 FM in more than ten languages.

cmsradio.org.au.name: CMS Radio
cmsradio.org.au.about: CMS Radio (Canberra Multicultural Service, 91.1 FM) is a multicultural community radio station in Canberra, governed by an elected executive board and affiliated with the Community Broadcasting Federation, serving the ACT's diverse ethnic communities.

coastfm.com.au.name: Coast FM
coastfm.com.au.about: Coast FM (88.7 FM) is a community radio station run by Southern & Western Community Broadcasters Inc. from Glandore in Adelaide, South Australia, offering a broad volunteer-presented music schedule across rock, pop, jazz and blues.

coastfm.org.au.name: Coast FM
coastfm.org.au.about: Coast FM 96.3 is a community radio station serving the NSW Central Coast on Darkinjung Country, broadcasting a classic hits format alongside news, local community programs and events coverage.

coastlive.com.au.name: Coast FM
coastlive.com.au.about: 97.3 Coast FM is a radio station serving Mandurah, Western Australia, with a contemporary music format alongside local news, entertainment and community content; it has been on air for around three decades.

colliecommunityradio.com.au.name: Collie Community Radio
colliecommunityradio.com.au.about: Collie Community Radio broadcasts on 101.3 FM to the town of Collie in Western Australia's South West region.

connectfm.au.name: Connect FM
connectfm.au.about: Connect FM (100.9 FM) is a multicultural community radio station serving the Bankstown-Auburn area of Sydney, broadcasting programs in languages including Macedonian, Hindi, Urdu, Punjabi, Kannada, Samoan and Filipino alongside English-language music and talk shows, on the lands of the Dharug and Eora nations.

coralcoastradio.net.au.name: Coral Coast Radio
coralcoastradio.net.au.about: Coral Coast Radio (94.7 FM) is a not-for-profit community radio station in Bundaberg, Queensland, established in 1999 by local enthusiasts and musicians. Run entirely by volunteers, it airs ethnic-language programming, breakfast and drive shows, listener requests, and religious and specialist music programs.

cow1079.org.name: COW FM
cow1079.org.about: COW FM ("Casino's Own Wireless", 107.9 FM) is a community radio station that has served the Richmond Valley area of northern NSW since 1994, and is a member of the Community Broadcasting Association of Australia.

crowfm.com.au.name: Crow FM
crowfm.com.au.about: Crow FM is a community radio station broadcasting on 90.7 FM to Wondai, Queensland, offering a community billboard, program guide and volunteer-run local programming.

cruise1323.com.au.name: Cruise 1323
cruise1323.com.au.about: Cruise 1323 (call sign 5DN) is one of Adelaide's longest-running commercial radio stations, having broadcast for more than 80 years as the market's first commercial station. Now owned by ARN Media, it broadcasts an easy listening format from studios on Tynte Street, North Adelaide.

crunchiefm.com.name: Crunchie FM
crunchiefm.com.about: Crunchie FM is a small Melbourne-based online radio station playing music "from the 80s to now" with no commercials and listener-driven song requests; little independent information about its ownership or history is publicly available.

curtinfm.com.au.name: Curtin Radio
curtinfm.com.au.about: Curtin Radio (formerly Curtin FM) is a community radio station broadcasting from Curtin University's Bentley campus in Perth. Founded in 1976, it began on the AM band at 927 kHz before switching to FM at 100.1 in 2001, mixing music programming with local talk content produced by students, staff and volunteers.

darwinfm.org.name: Darwin FM
darwinfm.org.about: Darwin FM (91.5) is a dance and party-music radio station based in Darwin, Northern Territory, that promotes and partners with local cultural events including the Darwin Aboriginal Art Fair, Darwin Fringe Festival and Darwin Festival.

dcfm889.com.au.name: DCFM 88.9
dcfm889.com.au.about: DCFM 88.9 is a community radio station based in Dubbo, NSW, offering local music and talk programming including First Nations content, alongside a community news hotline and local sponsorships.

diffusionfm.wordpress.com.name: Diffusion FM
diffusionfm.wordpress.com.about: Diffusion FM is a small independent microbroadcasting project based in the Waterloo/Marrickville area of Sydney, broadcasting on 91.9 FM as an experimental, community-oriented "other space for making radio", linked to the international radia.fm network of art radio stations.

dimensioneaustralia.net.name: Radio Dimensione Australia
dimensioneaustralia.net.about: Radio Dimensione Australia is an Italian-language web radio/podcast produced by Enrico Paterni, an Italian migrant based in Rostrevor, South Australia (where he also runs the Baretto cafe), sharing his perspective on Australian life in weekly episodes distributed via Spotify and Apple Podcasts.

disrupt.radio.name: Disrupt Radio
disrupt.radio.about: Disrupt Radio is an Australian digital talk radio station broadcasting on DAB+ and online, launched on 26 June 2023 with a focus on business, entrepreneurship and innovation. Its inaugural breakfast show was co-hosted by Libbi Gorr and Sir Bob Geldof.

djr0607.wixsite.com.name: All Time Hits Radio
djr0607.wixsite.com.about: This is a small, independently run internet radio operation (hosted on Wix under the username "djr0607") streaming general hits programming from Melbourne, plus a seasonal Christmas-themed channel each year; little further information about its operator is publicly available.

doublej.net.au.name: Double J
doublej.net.au.about: Double J is a national digital radio station run by the ABC's Triple J team, targeting older listeners with new music and archival content. It grew out of the 2009 rebrand of ABC's digital "Dig Music" channel and relaunched under the Double J name - a nod to Triple J's original call sign 2JJ - on 30 April 2014, with Myf Warhurst as its first on-air presenter.

eaglefm.com.au.name: Eagle FM
eaglefm.com.au.about: Eagle FM is a commercial radio station broadcasting to the Southern Tablelands of NSW on 93.5 FM in Goulburn and 103.7 FM in Crookwell, and is a member station of the Capital Radio Network.

eastsidefm.org.name: Eastside Radio
eastsidefm.org.about: Eastside Radio (89.7 FM, call sign 2RES) is a not-for-profit community radio station owned by the Radio Eastern Sydney Co-operative, broadcasting since 1983 from Paddington to Sydney's Eastern Suburbs and Inner West, with its signal reaching the Blue Mountains and online worldwide. It moved from mono to stereo broadcasting in 2014.

edge1021.com.au.name: Edge FM
edge1021.com.au.about: Edge FM 102.1 is a commercial radio station owned by Ace Radio, broadcasting an adult contemporary format to Wangaratta, Victoria.

edge1025.com.au.name: Edge FM
edge1025.com.au.about: Edge FM 102.5 is a commercial radio station owned by Ace Radio, broadcasting a contemporary music format to Deniliquin in the Riverina region of New South Wales.

edgefm.org.au.name: Edge FM
edgefm.org.au.about: Edge FM (93.7 FM) is the community radio station for the Bega Valley on the NSW South Coast, operated by Bega Access Radio Incorporated. It airs a wide-ranging music format from blues and jazz to metal and electronica, plus arts, technology and politics programming, and acknowledges the Djiringanj people as traditional custodians.

engineered.network.name: The Engineered Network
engineered.network.about: The Engineered Network is an Australian podcast and online audio network run by John Chidgey since around 2013, producing shows about engineering, technology, photography and renewable energy rather than operating as a conventional broadcast radio station.

firstnationsradio.org.name: First Nations Radio
firstnationsradio.org.about: First Nations Radio (94.5 FM) is an Indigenous-focused radio station based in Darwin, Northern Territory, describing itself as Australia's leading Indigenous radio station and also operating an associated First Nations TV service.

fleurieufm.org.au.name: Fleurieu FM
fleurieufm.org.au.about: Fleurieu FM is a community radio station serving the Victor Harbor area on South Australia's Fleurieu Peninsula.

flowfm.com.au.name: Flow FM
flowfm.com.au.about: Flow FM is an Australian online radio station operated by Flow Media, offering music programming, on-demand shows and a "Flow News 24" news service.

fm1031lovinglife.com.au.name: Loving Life FM
fm1031lovinglife.com.au.about: Loving Life FM (103.1) is a community Christian radio station based in Grafton, New South Wales, which had been broadcasting for around 25 years as of 2023 under the tagline "Local & Lovin' It".

fm876.com.au.name: Fresh FM
fm876.com.au.about: Fresh FM (87.6) is "Woolgoolga's own" community radio station on the NSW North Coast, playing a wide range of genres with a particular focus on supporting independent and local Australian artists.

fm985.com.au.name: One FM
fm985.com.au.about: One FM 98.5 is a community radio station serving Shepparton and the Goulburn Valley, broadcasting since 1989 with a "Live and Local" focus on community interviews, sport and multicultural programming.

frasercoast.fm.name: Fraser Coast FM
frasercoast.fm.about: Fraser Coast FM (107.5) is a volunteer-run community radio station serving Hervey Bay, Queensland, supported by the Community Broadcasting Foundation and affiliated with the Community Broadcasting Association of Australia.

fresh927.com.au.name: Fresh 92.7
fresh927.com.au.about: Fresh 92.7 (formerly Fresh FM) is a community radio station broadcasting on 92.7 FM and DAB+ in Adelaide, South Australia, and shares premises on Rundle Street with Radio Adelaide under a facilities partnership.

ginginsown1049.com.name: Gin Gin's Own
ginginsown1049.com.about: Gin Gin's Own (104.9 FM) is a community radio station in Gin Gin, Queensland, incorporated in March 2008 and officially opened on 26 January 2009. It holds a long-term licence from the ACMA and airs a broad music mix from the 1950s to today plus country and classical programming, presented by around 21 volunteers.

gippslandfm.org.au.name: Gippsland FM
gippslandfm.org.au.about: Gippsland FM (104.7) is a non-profit, volunteer-run community radio station that has served Victoria's Latrobe Valley for more than 50 years, broadcasting 24/7 with programming reflecting the diverse voices of the Gippsland region.

gippslandsgold.com.au.name: Gold 1242 & Gold FM
gippslandsgold.com.au.about: Gold 1242 & Gold FM 98.3 (call sign 3GV) is a commercial radio station owned by Ace Radio, broadcasting to the greater Gippsland region of Victoria, including Traralgon, Morwell and Sale, on both AM and FM frequencies.

gnfm.com.au.name: GNFM
gnfm.com.au.about: GNFM traces its history to 2GN, which began broadcasting on AM in the Goulburn region on 7 December 1931, one of regional NSW's oldest stations. After 90 years on AM, it switched to FM as GNFM 107.7 on 12 May 2022. It is co-owned by Capital Radio Network and Grant Broadcasters and plays a classic hits format alongside local news and community programming.

gold1017.com.au.name: Gold 101.7
gold1017.com.au.about: Gold 101.7 began as AM station 2WS, launched in Sydney's western suburbs in November 1978, and converted to FM in 1993. Bought by the Australian Radio Network (ARN) in 1994, it operated for decades as WSFM with a classic hits format before rebranding to Gold 101.7 in January 2025 as part of ARN's national Gold Network.

gold1043.com.au.name: Gold 104.3
gold1043.com.au.about: Gold 104.3 descends from 3KZ, an AM station that began broadcasting in Melbourne in December 1930. It won an FM licence and relaunched on 104.3 MHz in 1990, rebranding as Gold 104 in 1991. The station has been owned by the Australian Radio Network since the mid-1990s and plays an adult contemporary/classic hits format as the flagship of ARN's Gold Network.

goldcentralvictoria.com.au.name: Gold Central Victoria
goldcentralvictoria.com.au.about: Gold Central Victoria (3EL) is a commercial radio station based in Bendigo, broadcasting on 98.3 FM locally and 1071 AM across Bendigo, Ballarat, Maryborough, Castlemaine and Daylesford. It is owned by ARN Media and airs a classic hits/adult contemporary format as part of the national Gold Network.

goldendaysradio.com.name: Golden Days Radio
goldendaysradio.com.about: Golden Days Radio (3GDR) is a Melbourne community station broadcasting on 95.7 FM from Caulfield, aimed at senior listeners. It plays music from the 1920s to 1960s alongside old radio serials, jazz, light classics and comedy, run mostly by volunteers including several former radio professionals for over 30 years.

goldfieldsfm.org.au.name: Goldfields FM
goldfieldsfm.org.au.about: Goldfields FM is a volunteer-run community station serving the Central Goldfields region from Maryborough, Victoria. It began broadcasting in January 2007 following a community campaign under the Strengthening Goldfields Community banner, and received its full broadcasting licence in 2011.

govefm.com.au.name: Gove FM
govefm.com.au.about: Gove FM (8EAR) is a community radio station based in Nhulunbuy on the Gove Peninsula in East Arnhem Land, Northern Territory. It is the main locally produced radio service for the region, focusing on local music, news and community events.

greatsouthernfm.com.name: Great Southern FM
greatsouthernfm.com.about: Great Southern FM is Albany's only community radio station, beginning as a weekend-only broadcaster in November 1994 using borrowed equipment from a shared room in the local Italian Club. Now producing 12-14 hours of live radio daily, it is a volunteer-run, member-funded charity covering the Great Southern region of Western Australia from Albany to Bremer Bay, Walpole, Denmark and Mount Barker.

grip-sydney.myshopify.com.name: Grip Radio
grip-sydney.myshopify.com.about: Grip Radio is an online radio station run by Grip, a Sydney-based clothing brand built around a community/streetwear scene, streaming music mixes and shows tied to the brand's community events.

gulffm.com.au.name: Gulf FM
gulffm.com.au.about: Gulf FM (5GFM) is a volunteer-run community radio station based on South Australia's Copper Coast, broadcasting 24 hours a day from studios in Kadina on 89.3 FM to the Copper Coast and surrounding areas, with live announcers from 7am to midnight.

happyfm.org.au.name: 90.1 Happy FM
happyfm.org.au.about: 90.1 Happy FM is a community radio station serving the Southern Fleurieu region of South Australia, with outside broadcast studios in Victor Harbor and Goolwa. It began in 1994 broadcasting from a caravan overlooking Victor Harbor, and now covers Mount Compass, Strathalbyn, Goolwa, Middleton, Port Elliot, Victor Harbor and Yankalilla.

harmanradio.com.name: Harman Radio Australia
harmanradio.com.about: Harman Radio is a 24/7 Punjabi-language radio station broadcasting from Sydney, described as Australia's first live Punjabi radio service. It airs Punjabi and Hindi content including sport, culture and religious programming for the Indian/Punjabi diaspora across Australia, with additional studios in Melbourne, Coffs Harbour, Adelaide, Brisbane and Perth.

hawkesbury.radio.name: Hawkesbury Radio
hawkesbury.radio.about: Hawkesbury Radio began test broadcasts in 1978 as 2VTR-FM ("5 Towns Radio") and gained a full community licence in 1982, one of the first in Australia. Based in Windsor, NSW and broadcasting on 89.9 FM, it is volunteer-run and was notably the only Australian community station to hold NRL broadcast rights (Penrith Panthers, 1997-2009) and later Western Sydney Wanderers A-League rights.

hellenicradioperth.com.name: Hellenic Radio Perth
hellenicradioperth.com.about: Hellenic Radio Perth is a Greek-language community broadcaster serving Perth's Greek community, broadcasting 24 hours a day and promoting Greek culture, language and heritage.

highlandfm.org.au.name: Highland FM
highlandfm.org.au.about: Highland FM launched on air as 2WKT on 3 April 1987 and is an all-volunteer community station based in Bowral serving the NSW Southern Highlands, with a listening area stretching from Campbelltown to Marulan. It carries locally produced programming reflecting the community's diverse interests and has been available on iHeartRadio since March 2020.

highway61internetradio.com.name: Highway 61 Internet Radio
highway61internetradio.com.about: Highway 61 Internet Radio is a Hobart-based internet radio station playing a mix of classic rock, blues, country and adult contemporary music from the 1960s to today.

hobartfm.org.au.name: Hobart FM
hobartfm.org.au.about: Hobart FM (7THE) first went to air on 13 April 1977 under a Public Radio Licence and has broadcast continuously since, moving to its current Bellerive premises in 1992. It is a community and multicultural broadcaster serving Greater Hobart on 96.1 and 92.1 FM, with programming aimed largely at the 50+ demographic alongside specialist music and multicultural programs.

hope1032.com.au.name: Hope 103.2
hope1032.com.au.about: Hope 103.2 grew out of the Christian Broadcasting Association, which produced Christian content from Five Dock, Sydney from 1953 before launching as FM station 2CBA in March 1979 - Australia's first Christian FM station. After moves to Seven Hills and several rebrands (Heart 103.2 in 2007, Sydney's 1032 in 2008), it took its current name, Hope 103.2, in December 2008.

hot100fm.com.au.name: Hot 100
hot100fm.com.au.about: Hot 100 began broadcasting on 1 July 1991 as Darwin's first commercial radio station, on 100.1 MHz, with relays into Katherine and Jabiru. Along with sister stations Mix 104.9 and KIX Country, it was acquired by the Australian Radio Network in a 2021-22 deal for the former Grant Broadcasters regional network, and airs a hot adult contemporary format.

hot91.com.au.name: 91.1 Hot FM
hot91.com.au.about: 91.1 Hot FM (4MCY) launched on 27 October 2003 as the Sunshine Coast's third commercial radio station, based in Maroochydore and covering the Nambour area. It is owned by the Australian Radio Network and plays a contemporary hit radio format, with Zinc 96.1 as its sister station.

hotfm.org.au.name: Hot FM
hotfm.org.au.about: Hot FM is run by the Sunraysia Community Radio Association, which began broadcasting from Mildura in April 1991 on 106.7 and 90.7 FM, later adding a translator at Robinvale in 1995. With more than 50 volunteer presenters, it serves Mildura, Merbein, Irymple, Red Cliffs, Wentworth and Ouyen, offers Greek, Italian and Indian community programs, and shifted from country music to an adult contemporary/easy listening format in 2017.

i98fm.com.au.name: i98FM
i98fm.com.au.about: i98FM began as AM station 2OO in 1979, broadcasting from atop Wollongong's Grand Hotel, and converted to FM in June 1992 under its current name. It has been the Illawarra region's top-rating commercial station since 1995, and is owned by WIN Corporation, sharing facilities with WIN Television.

imccountryradio.com.name: IMC Country Radio
imccountryradio.com.about: IMC Country Radio is an online country music station based in Melton, Victoria, playing indie, mainstream and classic country music and running dedicated country music shows and artist promotions.

indianlink1.radioca.st.name: Indian Link Radio
indianlink1.radioca.st.about: Indian Link Radio launched in 2002 as Australia's first service of its kind, a 24/7 Hindi-language radio station broadcast out of Sydney and run by the Indian Link media group. Originally subscription-based for Sydney and Melbourne listeners, it now streams nationally with a mix of Bollywood, pop, ghazals and devotional music alongside interviews with Indian community and political figures.

innerfm.org.au.name: 96.5 Inner FM
innerfm.org.au.about: 96.5 Inner FM (3INR) grew out of a 1987 community meeting to establish a broadcaster for Melbourne's north-eastern suburbs, and after test broadcasts began full-time transmission on 10 December 1990. Run by around 60 volunteers from studios in Heidelberg, it serves the cities of Banyule, Manningham and Darebin with music and multicultural, legal and community-interest programming.

islam2day.org.name: Islam2Day
islam2day.org.about: Islam2Day is a Sydney-based Islamic dawah and media organisation, active since 2005, which runs an online radio stream featuring Quran recitation with English translation alongside other Islamic educational content.

islandfm.com.au.name: Island FM Whitsundays
islandfm.com.au.about: Island FM Whitsundays is a locally owned community station broadcasting on 88.0 FM to Airlie Beach, Cannonvale, Jubilee Pocket, Bowen, Collinsville, Hideaway Bay and Hamilton Island, focused on local news, information and music for the Whitsundays region.

italiafm.net.name: ItaliaFm
italiafm.net.about: ItaliaFm has broadcast online since 2004, playing decades of Italian-language pop, rock and melodic music hits for Italian communities across Australia, along with Italian-language news and social updates for the diaspora.

j-air.com.au.name: J-AIR
j-air.com.au.about: J-AIR is a volunteer-run station giving a voice to Melbourne's Jewish community, launched in 2014 and broadcasting on 88.0 FM around Caulfield as well as online, featuring Jewish culture, news, analysis, music and comedy.

katherinefm.org.au.name: Katherine FM
katherinefm.org.au.about: Katherine FM is a local community music and information station broadcasting on 101.3 FM from Katherine, Northern Territory, serving the Katherine and Big Rivers community.

kiis1011.com.au.name: KIIS 101.1
kiis1011.com.au.about: KIIS 101.1 traces back to 3DB, which first broadcast on AM in Melbourne on 21 February 1927. It converted to FM in 1990 and went through several names (101.1 TTFM, then Mix 101.1 from 2001) before becoming KIIS 101.1 in 2015. It is owned by the Australian Radio Network and airs a contemporary hit radio format.

kiis1065.com.au.name: KIIS 106.5
kiis1065.com.au.about: KIIS 106.5 descends from 2UW, which began broadcasting in Sydney on 13 February 1925 and in 1935 became the first station outside the United States to broadcast 24 hours a day. It moved to FM as Mix 106.5 in 1994 and rebranded as KIIS 1065 in 2014, and is owned today by ARN Media with a contemporary hit radio format.

kissfm.com.au.name: Kiss FM
kissfm.com.au.about: Kiss FM is a Melbourne-based online dance music station showcasing underground house, techno, progressive and drum and bass through live DJ sets and guest mixes, funded by listener memberships.

kixcountry.com.au.name: iHeartCountry Australia
kixcountry.com.au.about: Originally branded KIX Country, this is now iHeartCountry Australia, a national digital country music channel operated by the Australian Radio Network on the iHeartRadio platform.

kooriradio.com.name: Koori Radio
kooriradio.com.about: Koori Radio grew out of 1980s station Radio Redfern and began broadcasting via community station Radio Skid Row around 1993 under the Aboriginal-owned and operated Gadigal Information Service. It received a full-time citywide licence in 2001 and moved to its own frequency, 93.7 FM, in 2002, airing Indigenous Australian and world Indigenous music alongside news, current affairs and sport.

krrfm.org.au.name: KRR FM
krrfm.org.au.about: KRR is a community radio station serving the Kandos-Rylstone area of NSW on 98.7 FM, on air since 1993 and run by more than thirty volunteer announcers. It plays a broad music mix spanning country, bluegrass, jazz, rock and classics from the 1950s to today, alongside local news and events.

lafm.com.au.name: LAFM
lafm.com.au.about: LAFM is a commercial radio station broadcasting on 89.3 FM to Launceston and northern Tasmania, operated under licencee Bass Radio Pty Limited as part of the Australian Radio Network, offering local breakfast and drive shows alongside music programming.

lakemacquariefm.com.au.name: Lake Macquarie FM
lakemacquariefm.com.au.about: Lake Macquarie FM is a community radio station broadcasting on 97.3 FM to the Lake Macquarie area of NSW, run as a member-based community organisation with local shows, a newsroom and community sponsorship.

latinosfm.com.name: Latinos FM
latinosfm.com.about: Latinos FM has broadcast Latin American music to Sydney since 2001, on 98.5 FM and online, with a Spanish-language schedule that includes dedicated request and community talk shows for the local Latino community.

legacy.scahw.com.au.name: Triple M Sydney
legacy.scahw.com.au.about: Triple M Sydney began broadcasting on 2 August 1980 as one of the first two commercial FM stations in Sydney (alongside 2Day FM). Owned by Southern Cross Austereo, it has maintained a rock music identity for over four decades and today airs an active rock/classic rock format.

life-fm.com.au.name: Life FM
life-fm.com.au.about: Life FM is a non-denominational Christian community radio station broadcasting on 100.1 FM to Bathurst and the Central West of NSW, playing mainstream and Christian contemporary music alongside lifestyle and current-affairs programming.

lofty.org.au.name: Lofty 88.9
lofty.org.au.about: Lofty is a volunteer-run, donation-funded community radio station broadcasting on 88.9 FM from Mount Barker in the Adelaide Hills, South Australia, offering an inclusive platform for local community groups and free coverage of local events.

magic1059.com.au.name: Magic 105.9
magic1059.com.au.about: Magic 105.9 is a commercial radio station licensed to Spencer Gulf Broadcasters Pty Ltd, part of the Australian Radio Network, serving Port Pirie, Port Augusta, Whyalla and the Flinders Ranges region of South Australia with a contemporary hit radio format, local news and iHeartRadio network programming.

magic1278.com.au.name: Magic 1278
magic1278.com.au.about: Magic 1278 began as 3XY, founded by businessman Frank Thring and first broadcasting on 8 September 1935. It adopted the Magic branding in 1993 and moved to the 1278 AM frequency in 2006, and after periods as a sports and lifestyle station returned to a classic 1950s-70s oldies music format in 2020. It is owned by Tapt Media and operated under lease by Ace Radio.

magic876.com.au.name: Magic 87.6
magic876.com.au.about: Magic 87.6 is a "Good Time Oldies" radio station broadcasting to the Mudgee, Kandos and Gulgong area of the NSW Central West (branded as Midwest Radio).

mainfm.net.name: MAINfm
mainfm.net.about: 94.9 MAINfm is a not-for-profit community radio station run by Castlemaine District Radio Inc, broadcasting across Central Victoria from Castlemaine on Dja Dja Wurrung country. It runs more than 70 volunteer-presented shows covering music, community news and specialist programs, supported by around 100 volunteers and over 750 subscribers.

mama.net.au.name: Radio MAMA
mama.net.au.about: Radio MAMA is run by the Midwest Aboriginal Media Association, a community media organisation serving Aboriginal communities in Western Australia's Mid West region with local news, live radio, podcasts and community-event coverage.

mbslight.com.au.name: MBS Light
mbslight.com.au.about: MBS Light is a digital sister station of Brisbane's 4MBS Classic FM (a registered charity), playing lighter classical music, waltzes, jazz, operetta and stage and screen music.

melodia.au.name: Radio Melodia
melodia.au.about: Radio Melodia is a Greek-language music and news broadcaster serving Adelaide's Greek community, on air since 2014 and managed by Panagiotis Mavraidis, broadcasting locally on VHF as well as streaming online.

mix1023.com.au.name: Mix 102.3
mix1023.com.au.about: This station began as 5AD, which first broadcast in Adelaide on 2 August 1930. Owned by the Australian Radio Network since 2001, it operated for years as Mix 102.3 with an adult contemporary format before ARN rebranded it KIIS 1023 with a contemporary hit radio format.

mix1049.com.au.name: Mix 104.9
mix1049.com.au.about: Mix 104.9 began broadcasting in Darwin in 1997 as the city's second commercial radio station, after sister station Hot 100. Formerly part of Grant Broadcasters, it was acquired by the Australian Radio Network in a deal finalised in January 2022, and airs a full-service adult contemporary format for the Top End.

mix106.com.au.name: Mix 106.3
mix106.com.au.about: Mix 106.3 launched in Canberra on 27 February 1988 as "KIX 106," one of Australia's first supplementary FM licensees. It later rebranded through several names as its owners (ARN and Southern Cross Austereo, in a long-running joint venture) shifted its format toward an older adult-hits audience.

mixx1013.com.au.name: Mixx FM
mixx1013.com.au.about: Mixx FM is a regional commercial radio brand broadcasting to Horsham, Ararat and Nhill in Victoria's Wimmera region on 101.3, 98.5 and 94.5 FM.

mixx1063.com.au.name: Mixx FM
mixx1063.com.au.about: Mixx FM is a regional commercial radio brand broadcasting to Colac and Apollo Bay in south-west Victoria on 106.3 and 95.9 FM.

mixx1077.com.au.name: Mixx FM
mixx1077.com.au.about: Mixx FM is a regional commercial radio brand broadcasting to Swan Hill and Kerang in north-west Victoria on 107.7 and 98.7 FM.

mixx889.com.au.name: Mixx FM
mixx889.com.au.about: Mixx FM is a regional commercial radio brand broadcasting to Hamilton and Portland in south-west Victoria on 88.9 and 93.7 FM.

movefm.com.au.name: Move FM
movefm.com.au.about: Move FM opened in 1996 as Kiss 95.3, operated by Midwest Radio Network, before shifting frequency to 107.9 FM and rebranding as Move FM in 2011. It is a commercial contemporary hit station serving Lithgow and the NSW Central Tablelands, the FM sister of AM station 2LT, with a repeater at Wentworth Falls extending coverage into the Blue Mountains.

mtmfm.org.au.name: MTM FM
mtmfm.org.au.about: MTM FM, "the Voice of Coonamble," is a community radio station run by Coonamble Community Radio Inc on 91.9 FM, broadcasting local news and programming for the Coonamble area of NSW.

mygc.com.au.name: Hot Tomato
mygc.com.au.about: Hot Tomato first went to air on 1 August 2003, and was the first Queensland station built around a "limited ad break" concept. Grant Broadcasters bought the station in 2018, before it passed to the Australian Radio Network in the 2021-22 acquisition of Grant's regional network. It airs an adult contemporary format produced entirely from the Gold Coast.

mylifefm.com.name: 107.9 Life FM
mylifefm.com.about: 107.9 Life FM is an Adelaide community radio station built around Christian faith values, broadcasting family-focused, positive content and music across lifestyle, faith and news programming.

noongarradio.com.name: Noongar Radio
noongarradio.com.about: Noongar Radio describes itself as Boorloo (Perth)'s only Indigenous radio station, giving voice to the Whadjuk Noongar people and the broader Perth community, and is a member of the Community Broadcasting Association of Australia.

noosafm.org.name: Noosa FM
noosafm.org.about: Noosa FM is a not-for-profit, volunteer-run community broadcaster established in 1994, expanding to round-the-clock broadcasting in 1997. Each presenter curates their own program, giving Noosa FM a diverse music and talk schedule, and the station promotes local events, artists and emergency services messaging for the Noosa area of Queensland.

northsideradio.com.au.name: Northside Radio
northsideradio.com.au.about: Northside Radio (2NSB, 99.3 FM) is the second-oldest sub-metropolitan community radio station in Sydney, run as a volunteer cooperative of around 120 people serving the North Shore with free airtime for non-profits and local event information.

northwestfm.org.name: North West FM
northwestfm.org.about: North West FM was established by the North West Community Radio Association, making its first transmission from Broadmeadows TAFE College in November 1988, gaining a full-time licence in 1990 and starting regular broadcasts on 4 April 1993 on 98.9 FM. It serves Melbourne's north-western suburbs and has more recently operated under the name Nest Radio.

nova100.com.au.name: Nova 100
nova100.com.au.about: Nova 100 launched at 7am on 3 December 2001 after DMG Radio paid $70 million for an FM licence, becoming Melbourne's first new commercial station in two decades, with Kate Langbroek among its inaugural on-air team. Now owned by Nova Entertainment, it shifted from an alternative/dance launch format to adult contemporary from around 2010.

nova1069.com.au.name: Nova 106.9
nova1069.com.au.about: Nova 106.9 launched on 4 April 2005 after DMG Radio paid $80 million for Brisbane's FM licence in 2004. Owned by Nova Entertainment and broadcasting from Teneriffe, it airs a Top 40 contemporary hit radio format and has served as an official FM partner for State of Origin and several Brisbane sporting teams.

nova919.com.au.name: Nova 919
nova919.com.au.about: Nova 919 launched in August 2004 after DMG Radio won Adelaide's FM licence at auction for $24 million, beating bids from Macquarie Radio, RG Capital, Hot Tomato and ARN. Owned by Nova Entertainment, it airs a Top 40 contemporary hit radio format under call sign 5ADL.

nova937.com.au.name: Nova 93.7
nova937.com.au.about: Nova 93.7 began broadcasting at 3pm on 5 December 2002, becoming Perth's second commercial FM station without prior AM history, after its owners paid A$25 million for the licence. It is jointly owned by Nova Entertainment and ARN Media and airs a Top 40 contemporary hit radio format.

nova969.com.au.name: Nova 96.9
nova969.com.au.about: Nova 96.9 began broadcasting on 1 April 2001 after DMG Radio paid $155 million for Sydney's FM licence, launching with former Triple J duo Merrick & Rosso on breakfast. Owned by Nova Entertainment and based in Pyrmont, it airs a contemporary hit radio format and sponsors Sydney FC and the GWS Giants.

oakfm.com.au.name: Oak FM
oakfm.com.au.about: Oak FM is a non-profit community station in Wangaratta, north-east Victoria, founded by local musician Peter Reynolds after commercial radio's poor treatment of a locally written anniversary song inspired him to build a platform for local artists. Its name is an acronym for the Ovens and King rivers that meet at Wangaratta, and it focuses heavily on promoting local and otherwise unheard Australian musicians.

ocrfm.org.au.name: OCR FM
ocrfm.org.au.about: OCR FM (Otways Community Radio, 3OCR) has operated for around 30 years, evolving from Colac Public Radio and then Otway FM before adopting its current name once granted a full broadcasting licence. A volunteer-run, all-ages station, it broadcasts 24/7 on 98.3 FM in Colac and District and 88.7 FM at Apollo Bay, serving south-west Victoria with local programming and free community announcements.

netfm.net.name: NetFM
netfm.net.about: NetFM, established in October 1998 and archived by Australia's National Film and Sound Archive, describes itself as one of the world's first professional 24/7 internet-only radio stations. Based in Sydney, it plays a classic rock format with human-curated shows and has been publicly endorsed by Apple co-founder Steve Wozniak.

outbackradio.com.au.name: Outback Radio 2WEB
outbackradio.com.au.about: Outback Radio 2WEB first went to air on 13 November 1978 as a school project at Bourke High School. It is a community radio station owned by WREB Co-Operative Limited, broadcasting on 585 AM to Bourke and far-western NSW with FM repeaters in Nyngan, Coonamble, Walgett, Lightning Ridge and Wilcannia. In 2021 the station purchased Bourke's threatened local newspaper, the Western Herald, and now helps produce it.
