ozmademusic.online.name: Pure Hits Australian Made
ozmademusic.online.about: Pure Hits Australian Made is an internet radio channel dedicated to Australian pop and rock, operated by Pure Hits Digital, a Melbourne-based digital radio company that streams themed music channels for retail and business use across Australia, Asia, Europe and the US.

paradisefm.org.au.name: Paradise FM
paradisefm.org.au.about: Paradise FM (2PAR) is a not-for-profit community radio station that has served Ballina Shire on 101.9 FM since 2001. Entirely volunteer-run and reliant on community support rather than government funding, it has backed more than 150 local charities alongside general entertainment and emergency-information programming.

pawmedia.com.au.name: PAW Media
pawmedia.com.au.about: PAW Media and Communications is a remote Indigenous media organisation based in Yuendumu in the Tanami Desert, Northern Territory. It began in 1983 as the Warlpiri Media Association, one of Australia's pioneering Aboriginal-owned media outfits, and took its current trading name in 2006. It now operates 8PAW Radio and ten Remote Indigenous Broadcasting Studios serving Warlpiri, Pintubi and Anmatjerre communities across a 140,000 sq km region.

phoenixfm.org.au.name: Phoenix FM
phoenixfm.org.au.about: Phoenix FM is a community radio station in Bendigo, Victoria, broadcasting on 106.7 FM. It followed an inaugural public meeting in April 2007 and began test broadcasting in January 2008. Run by more than 100 volunteer members and presenters, it carries multicultural, Indigenous, youth, gospel, folk and general music programming alongside national news.

plasticage.com.au.name: PlasticAge Radio
plasticage.com.au.about: PlasticAge Radio is described as Adelaide's first online radio station, established in 1999 and reportedly the first Australian internet station listed on iTunes Radio. It streams underground electronic, techno, trance and dance music around the clock with a mix of local and international DJs.

podcast.harmanradio.com.name: Harman Radio Australia
podcast.harmanradio.com.about: Harman Radio Australia describes itself as Australia's first 24-hour live Punjabi radio station, broadcasting from Sydney with music and talk programming aimed at promoting Punjabi language and culture within Australia's multicultural community.

portugueseradio.com.name: Portuguese Radio Australia
portugueseradio.com.about: Portuguese Radio Australia is a 24-hour Portuguese-language broadcaster established in 1992 and based in Petersham, in Sydney's Inner West, home to Australia's largest Portuguese-Australian community. It operates as the radio arm of the Portuguese-language newspaper Jornal Português, airing music, interviews and listener-participation programming.

positive91five.org.name: Positive 91FIVE (Cooloola Christian Radio)
positive91five.org.about: Positive 91FIVE is Gympie's community Christian radio station, run by Cooloola Christian Radio. A steering committee formed in 1995 by local Full Gospel Business Men's Fellowship members pursued a broadcasting licence, which was granted as a full-time Community Broadcasting Licence on 1 April 2002. The station has broadcast from a former Gympie Uniting Church building on Parsons Road since 2005.

power100.com.au.name: Power100
power100.com.au.about: Power100 is a commercial radio station in Townsville, Queensland, broadcasting on 100.7 FM with an active rock format. Launched in 1999 as Sea FM by RG Capital, it passed through several owners including Macquarie Southern Cross, Prime Media Group and Grant Broadcasters, was rebranded from Zinc 100.7 to Power100 in 2016, and has been owned by the Australian Radio Network since a 2022 acquisition of Grant Broadcasters' stations.

powercutsradio.com.name: Power Cuts Radio
powercutsradio.com.about: Power Cuts Radio is a Sydney-based independent internet radio station dedicated to reggae, dancehall and dub music, run by Jamaican-born reggae promoter and presenter Ted Vassell, who has been involved in Australian community radio since 1991.

powerfmballarat.com.au.name: Power FM
powerfmballarat.com.au.about: Power FM (3BBA) is a commercial radio station broadcasting to Ballarat and surrounding central Victorian towns on 103.1 FM. It first went to air in April 1996 with a contemporary hit music format and is owned, alongside sister station 3BA, by the Australian Radio Network.

powerfmbegabay.com.au.name: Power FM Bega Bay
powerfmbegabay.com.au.about: Power FM Bega Bay is a commercial radio station serving the NSW far south coast, broadcasting on 102.5 FM to the Bega Valley and 104.3 FM to the Eurobodalla Shire, covering Bega, Batemans Bay, Narooma, Merimbula, Eden and Moruya. It first aired on 24 September 1997 and has been owned by the Australian Radio Network since a 2022 acquisition of Grant Broadcasters.

progrockmachine.com.name: The Prog Rock Machine
progrockmachine.com.about: The Prog Rock Machine is a specialist progressive-rock program and internet radio stream based in Ballarat, Victoria, exploring the history of prog-rock artists and albums from the 1950s to today. It has been running for over a decade and is syndicated to several Australian community stations in addition to its own online stream.

psrfm.org.au.name: 100.9 Port Stephens FM
psrfm.org.au.about: 100.9 Port Stephens FM is a community radio station based in Salamander Bay, NSW. Its first test transmission went to air on 1 April 1993 from a mobile studio caravan, and it moved onto a full-time broadcasting licence in July 1998. It broadcasts 24/7 to the Port Stephens local government area with council news, emergency announcements and community programming.

pulse899fm.com.au.name: Pulse 89.9 FM
pulse899fm.com.au.about: Pulse 89.9FM is the Hawkesbury region's community radio station, operated by the Hawkesbury Community Media Network Association and based in Richmond, NSW. It was awarded a full community broadcasting licence by the ACMA on 6 December 2022 and plays a mix of Australian country and vintage rock and roll alongside local news and sport.

pulse941.com.au.name: Pulse 94.1
pulse941.com.au.about: Pulse 94.1 is the Illawarra's Christian community radio station, broadcasting from Coniston, NSW. It began as Living Sound Broadcasters on a temporary licence in February 1998, gained a permanent full-time licence in November 2000, and relaunched under the Pulse 94.1 name in March 2012; its licence area extends into the Shoalhaven due to its founding church ties.

pulsefmtas.com.au.name: Pulse FM
pulsefmtas.com.au.about: Pulse FM is a hits and Top 40-format radio station broadcasting to the Hobart, Kingborough and Huon areas of Tasmania on 87.6/87.8 FM.

purehitsretro.com.name: Pure Hits RETRO
purehitsretro.com.about: Pure Hits RETRO is an internet radio channel from Pure Hits Digital, a Melbourne-based digital radio company that streams themed music channels for retail and business use across Australia and internationally. It plays classic pop and rock hits from the 1980s through the 2010s.

pvfm.org.au.name: Plenty Valley FM
pvfm.org.au.about: Plenty Valley FM (3PVR) is a community radio station based in Mill Park in Melbourne's north, broadcasting on 88.6 FM since 1987. It serves the City of Banyule, City of Manningham, City of Whittlesea and Shire of Nillumbik, and is the official emergency broadcaster for Banyule, Nillumbik and Whittlesea.

qbn967.com.au.name: QBN FM
qbn967.com.au.about: QBN FM is a volunteer-run, non-profit community radio station broadcasting from Queanbeyan, NSW on 96.7 FM since April 2000. It is a full member of the Community Broadcasting Association of Australia and plays a mix of classic pop and rock, country, Irish folk and nostalgia.

qram.com.au.name: QRAM / Black Star Radio
qram.com.au.about: QRAM (Queensland Remote Aboriginal Media) is a Cairns-based Indigenous media organisation that runs Black Star Radio, an all-digital network providing programming support to local Aboriginal community radio sites across remote Far North Queensland, the Gulf and Cape York. The first Black Star site launched at Bamaga in August 2011; by 2022 the network reached more than 30 communities via 17 local stations.

radio-australia.org.name: 2ME Radio Arabic
radio-australia.org.about: 2ME is Australia's first 24-hour, commercially-owned Arabic-language radio station, broadcasting since 1996 from Parramatta, Sydney, with Melbourne transmissions added in 1998. It airs Arabic and English music, local and BBC World News, and talkback programming, narrowcasting on AM frequencies to Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Adelaide, Perth, Canberra, Hobart and Darwin.

radio.sydney.name: Radio.Sydney
radio.sydney.about: Radio.Sydney is an Australian internet radio station streaming a broad, varied music mix, marketed as "Australia's #1 online radio station."

radio.visionaustralia.org.name: Vision Australia Radio
radio.visionaustralia.org.about: Vision Australia Radio is the current name of Australia's national Radio for the Print Handicapped (RPH) network, which grew out of programs on Melbourne access stations 3ZZ and 3CR in the 1970s. Federal funding from 1981-82 helped establish dedicated reading services -- Hobart's 7RPH went to air in 1982, Melbourne's 3RPH the same year, and Brisbane and Canberra services followed by 1984-85 -- reading newspapers, magazines and books aloud for people who are blind or have print disabilities.

radio1629am.net.name: Radio 1629 AM
radio1629am.net.about: Radio 1629 AM is a community narrowcast station in Newcastle, NSW, originally established as HRN (Hospital Radio Newcastle) by former ABC presenter Brian Blacklock to entertain hospital patients. It now broadcasts easy-listening music from the 1930s-60s and beyond to the wider Newcastle area.

radio1rph.org.au.name: Radio 1RPH
radio1rph.org.au.about: 1RPH is a volunteer-run community radio reading service for people who are blind or have difficulty reading print, broadcasting to Canberra on 1125 AM (plus Wagga Wagga and Junee) since it first went to air on 5 October 1992. About 120 volunteers present daily live news-reading programs.

radio2cbd.com.au.name: 2CBD FM
radio2cbd.com.au.about: 2CBD FM is Glen Innes's community radio station, incorporated in April 1997 and broadcasting on 105.9 FM in Glen Innes and 91.1 FM in Deepwater. Run by around 30 volunteers, it was the district's first successful community radio venture after an earlier attempt decades prior failed for lack of support.

radio2rdj.com.name: 2RDJ-FM
radio2rdj.com.about: 2RDJ-FM is a community radio station based in Burwood serving Sydney's Inner West, providing local residents open access to broadcasting facilities. It went to air at 7am on 5 November 1983, following test transmissions dating back to 1975.

radio2tripleo.com.au.name: 2TripleO
radio2tripleo.com.au.about: 2TripleO is Sydney's largest public multilingual broadcaster, airing content in over 50 languages across FM 98.5 and DAB+. It is operated by the Multicultural Community Radio Association (MCRA Ltd), a non-profit that holds a Community Broadcasting Licence, with more than 300 volunteer broadcasters producing programming for Sydney's diverse language communities.

radio567.com.au.name: Radio 567 - XRN Australia
radio567.com.au.about: Radio 567 (XRN Australia) is a niche radio stream broadcasting from Wee Waa, NSW, playing rock and roll, disco and rockabilly hits from the 1950s to 1970s under the tagline "the soundtrack to simpler times."

radioadelaide.com.au.name: Radio Adelaide (Australian Digital Radio Network)
radioadelaide.com.au.about: This is the Adelaide stream of the Australian Digital Radio Network (marketed as iDigital Radio), a commercial internet simulcast service running matching non-stop music channels branded for each Australian state capital. It is a separate service from -- and should not be confused with -- the university-affiliated community station Radio Adelaide (5UV).

radiobluesdjerdan.com.au.name: Radio Blues Djerdan
radiobluesdjerdan.com.au.about: Radio Blues Djerdan is a Melbourne-based internet radio station run by Vladimir Bera, streaming blues music around the clock as a sister stream to Bera's roots/country-focused Radio Djerdan.

radiobrisbane.com.au.name: Radio Brisbane (Australian Digital Radio Network)
radiobrisbane.com.au.about: This is the Brisbane stream of the Australian Digital Radio Network (marketed as iDigital Radio), a commercial internet simulcast service running matching non-stop music channels branded for each Australian state capital.

radiocanberra.com.au.name: Radio Canberra (Australian Digital Radio Network)
radiocanberra.com.au.about: This is the Canberra stream of the Australian Digital Radio Network (marketed as iDigital Radio), a commercial internet simulcast service running matching non-stop music channels branded for each Australian state capital.

radiocarrum.org.name: Radio Carrum
radiocarrum.org.about: Radio Carrum is a not-for-profit online community radio station centred on Carrum Primary School in the City of Kingston, Melbourne. It commenced broadcasting on 11 May 2012 with a student program, Carrum Kids Radio, and now carries shows made by students, teachers and local community members from the Kingston area.

radiodarwin.com.au.name: Radio Darwin (Australian Digital Radio Network)
radiodarwin.com.au.about: This is the Darwin stream of the Australian Digital Radio Network (marketed as iDigital Radio), a commercial internet simulcast service running matching non-stop music channels branded for each Australian state capital.

radiodjerdan.com.au.name: Radio Djerdan
radiodjerdan.com.au.about: Radio Djerdan is a Melbourne-based internet radio station run by Vladimir Bera, focused on roots, blues, country, folk, Americana and bluegrass music.

radioeasternfm.com.au.name: Radio Eastern FM
radioeasternfm.com.au.about: Radio Eastern FM (3ECB) is a community radio station based in Croydon serving Melbourne's outer-eastern suburbs -- Knox, Maroondah, Whitehorse, Manningham and Yarra Ranges -- on 98.1 FM, with an easy-listening music format streamed online 24/7.

radioemfm.org.au.name: EMFM - Echuca Moama Community Radio
radioemfm.org.au.about: EMFM is a not-for-profit, volunteer-run community radio station broadcasting on 104.7 FM to the twin towns of Echuca (Victoria) and Moama (NSW) and surrounding districts bordered by Mathoura, Torrumbarry, Lockington, Elmore and Kyabram. It received its full broadcasting licence on 4 November 1997 and offers local music, interviews, news and emergency-warning coverage that commercial stations don't provide.

radiofreedom.com.au.name: Radio Freedom
radiofreedom.com.au.about: Radio Freedom is an independent internet radio station streaming house, techno, trance, dubstep, rap and ambient electronic music from Australian and international unsigned producers and DJs.

radiogoolwa-alexfm.com.au.name: Alex FM
radiogoolwa-alexfm.com.au.about: Alex FM is Goolwa's community radio station in South Australia, broadcasting 24/7 on 91.5 FM from the old Railway Superintendent's Cottage. It was founded by a group of former Great Southern FM announcers and local business owners at a meeting in November 2001 and incorporated in January 2002, reaching towns across the Southern Fleurieu including Tailem Bend, Murray Bridge and Mount Barker.

radiogreatsouthern.com.name: Radio Great Southern
radiogreatsouthern.com.about: Radio Great Southern is a community radio station broadcasting from Wagin, Western Australia on 1422 AM (with a sister easy-listening service on 1611 AM), providing adult contemporary music and news to the Great Southern region.

radiohobart.com.au.name: Radio Hobart (Australian Digital Radio Network)
radiohobart.com.au.about: This is the Hobart stream of the Australian Digital Radio Network (marketed as iDigital Radio), a commercial internet simulcast service running matching non-stop music channels branded for each Australian state capital.

radioitaliana531.com.au.name: Radio Italiana 531
radioitaliana531.com.au.about: Radio Italiana 531 is one of Adelaide's dedicated non-English-language radio services, serving South Australia's Italian community. Its roots trace to earlier Radio Paesani programming, with Radio Italiana formally founded under a new constitution in December 1978; it has broadcast on 531 AM for decades as a pillar of Adelaide's Italian-Australian community.

radioitalianmusic.com.name: Radio Italian Music
radioitalianmusic.com.about: Radio Italian Music is a Sydney-based internet radio station playing Italian pop, popular and folk music, including artists such as Eros Ramazzotti and Laura Pausini.

radiomansfield.org.au.name: Radio Mansfield
radiomansfield.org.au.about: Radio Mansfield (99.7FM) is a community radio station in Mansfield, in Victoria's high country, broadcasting 24/7 since 15 December 1997. It carries local news, weather and community information alongside country, blues, jazz, classical, Celtic and rock music, and is an accredited emergency broadcaster.

radiomelbourne.com.au.name: Radio Melbourne (Australian Digital Radio Network)
radiomelbourne.com.au.about: This is the Melbourne stream of the Australian Digital Radio Network (marketed as iDigital Radio), a commercial internet simulcast service running matching non-stop music channels branded for each Australian state capital.

radioperth.com.au.name: Radio Perth (Australian Digital Radio Network)
radioperth.com.au.about: This is the Perth stream of the Australian Digital Radio Network (marketed as iDigital Radio), a commercial internet simulcast service running matching non-stop music channels branded for each Australian state capital.

radiosydney.com.au.name: Radio Sydney (Australian Digital Radio Network)
radiosydney.com.au.about: This is the Sydney stream of the Australian Digital Radio Network (marketed as iDigital Radio), a commercial internet simulcast service running matching non-stop music channels branded for each Australian state capital.

radiouppermurray.com.au.name: Radio Upper Murray
radiouppermurray.com.au.about: Radio Upper Murray is a community radio station serving the cross-border Walwa, Corryong and Tumbarumba districts on the Victoria-NSW border, broadcasting on 88.7, 98.9 and 107.7 FM.

radiox.com.au.name: Radio X AU
radiox.com.au.about: Radio X AU, branded "Australia's Ultimate Rock Station," is an online rock-format radio station operated by Dare Media Group, which also runs sister stations Radio X Gold, Dare Talk Radio and 6RXM Radio X Magic.

ramfm.com.au.name: RAMfm
ramfm.com.au.about: RAMfm is a community-owned radio station in Goulburn, NSW, broadcasting on 103.3 FM. It began in 1987 as the Goulburn Community Radio Association, operating under callsign 2GCR as Goulburn's first FM station, and rebranded as RAMfm on 1 January 2019, referencing the city's Big Merino landmark.

ratfm.com.name: RatFM
ratfm.com.about: RatFM, describing itself as "the little internet station with BIG ambitions," is a Victoria-based internet radio station combining rock music with talkback and listener song requests, run largely by volunteer presenters.

rawfmradio.com.au.name: Raw FM
rawfmradio.com.au.about: Raw FM is an Australian-run internet radio station streaming continuous dance, house, EDM, hip-hop and trap music, including internationally syndicated programs such as Tiësto's Club Life and Oliver Heldens' Heldeep Radio.

rbm.org.au.name: Radio Blue Mountains
rbm.org.au.about: Radio Blue Mountains is an all-volunteer, not-for-profit community radio station established in 1993 and based in Katoomba, NSW. It broadcasts to around 75,000 residents across the Blue Mountains and streams online worldwide, sustained by listener support, grants and limited sponsorship.

readingradio.org.au.name: 4RPH Reading Radio
readingradio.org.au.about: 4RPH (Reading Radio) is a Brisbane-based community radio reading service for people with print disability, broadcasting on 1296 AM and DAB+. Established in 1978 with government funding as Queensland Radio for the Print Handicapped, it initially aired for one hour a day on 4MBS before becoming an independent, full station in February 1984.

reteitalia.com.au.name: Rete Italia
reteitalia.com.au.about: Rete Italia is an Italian-language internet radio station broadcasting from Melbourne and Sydney, offering Italian music, cultural programs, news and podcasts around the clock for Australia's Italian community.

rhema.cc.name: Rhema Central Coast
rhema.cc.about: Rhema Central Coast is a Christian community radio station broadcasting to Gosford, NSW on 94.9 FM, offering worship music, family-focused teaching programs and faith-based content. It is a member of the Community Broadcasting Association of Australia and receives Community Broadcasting Foundation grants.

rhema.fm.name: Rhema Wide Bay
rhema.fm.about: Rhema Wide Bay is a Christian community radio station broadcasting on 105.1 FM from Pialba (Hervey Bay), Queensland, offering worship and teaching programming, prayer resources and community news.

rhemafm.com.au.name: Rhema FM
rhemafm.com.au.about: Rhema FM is a not-for-profit, community-funded Christian radio station broadcasting on 99.7 FM in Newcastle, NSW, running a main music stream alongside dedicated Worship and Still channels, devotionals and talk shows. It is a member of the Community Broadcasting Association of Australia.

rimfm.org.name: Rim FM
rimfm.org.about: Rim FM (100.1) is a volunteer-run, not-for-profit community radio station serving southeast Queensland and northern New South Wales, also streaming worldwide online. It has been operating for around 25 years, playing music of all genres and supporting independent artists and labels with airplay.

river1467.com.au.name: River 1467
river1467.com.au.about: River 1467 (3ML) is a commercial radio station broadcasting to the Sunraysia region from Mildura, Victoria on 1467 AM. It is owned by Grant Broadcasters and has changed hands between several networks over the years, including a period as EasyMix 1467 under Southern Cross Austereo/AMI Radio.

rnb.org.au.name: Radio Northern Beaches
rnb.org.au.about: Radio Northern Beaches is a community radio station covering Sydney's northern beaches from Manly to Palm Beach, broadcasting on 88.7 and 90.3 FM. It is run by the Manly-Warringah Media Co-operative and produces more than 55 locally-made weekly programs; its long-running "Praise and Worship" show has aired since 1985.

rocketrangeradio.com.name: Rocket Range Radio
rocketrangeradio.com.about: Rocket Range Radio broadcasts as "107.3 Triple-R FM Woomera" from the historic rocket-testing town of Woomera, South Australia, and also hosts Armed Forces Radio Australia (AFRA) internet radio.

roqradio.com.au.name: ROQ FM
roqradio.com.au.about: ROQ FM, branded "Australia's Favourite ROQ," is a rock-format radio station operated by Exalt Media Pty Ltd, featuring a weekly Classic Album of the Week segment and drive-time programming.

rosecityfm.org.au.name: Rose City FM
rosecityfm.org.au.about: Rose City FM is Warwick's only local radio station, a volunteer-driven, not-for-profit community broadcaster owned by the Warwick Community FM Radio Association. It first went to air on 23 October 1995 on 89.3 FM, serving the Southern Downs region of Queensland.

rppfm.com.au.name: RPP FM
rppfm.com.au.about: RPP FM is the Mornington Peninsula's community radio and television network, broadcasting on 98.7 and 98.3 FM from studios in Mornington and Frankston to more than 350,000 people around the Peninsula, Frankston, southern Kingston, Geelong and the Western Port/Port Phillip Bay areas. It grew out of the Radio Port Phillip Association, incorporated in 1984 to seek a community broadcasting licence, and today has more than 280 members and 85 active volunteer broadcasters.

sawtelghad.com.au.name: Radio 2Moro (Sawt El Ghad)
sawtelghad.com.au.about: Radio 2Moro (Sawt El Ghad) is a 24-hour Arabic-language radio station broadcasting to Sydney on 1620 AM since December 2002. Affiliated with Sawt El Ghad in Lebanon and distributed by World Media International (which also carries Greek and Italian programming in Australia), it is among the most listened-to Arabic-language stations in the country.

sawtsydney.com.au.name: Sawt Sydney
sawtsydney.com.au.about: Sawt Sydney bills itself as Sydney's first Arabic digital radio service, streaming news, podcasts and shows for the city's Arabic-speaking community via its website and app rather than a traditional FM signal.

sbs.com.au.name: SBS Chill
sbs.com.au.about: SBS Chill is one of the digital radio stations operated by SBS Audio (formerly SBS Radio), the multilingual broadcaster that began as ethnic radio stations 2EA (Sydney) and 3EA (Melbourne) in 1975 and became a statutory service, the Special Broadcasting Service, in 1978. SBS Chill streams chillout and ambient world music alongside SBS's other digital stations such as PopAsia and Arabic24.

seymourfm.au.name: Seymour FM
seymourfm.au.about: Seymour FM (103.9) is a community radio station run by Seymour Puckapunyal Community Radio Inc, broadcasting from Seymour in central Victoria. It is a member of the Community Broadcasting Association of Australia and airs genre-focused music programs spanning blues, rock, country, hip hop and Australian bush ballads.

skylab-radio.com.name: Skylab Radio
skylab-radio.com.about: Skylab Radio is an independent, nonprofit online community radio station launched in April 2018 from Romantica Studios in East Brunswick, Melbourne. It showcases eclectic music selected by local and international presenters and has received support from City of Melbourne community and local-artist programs.

skynews.com.au.name: Sky News Australia Radio
skynews.com.au.about: Sky News Australia Radio is the audio simulcast of the Sky News Australia television channel, delivering rolling news, opinion and commentary. It was distributed via iHeartRadio from March 2020 under a deal with ARN, then moved to a partnership with Nova Entertainment in June 2023, now carried nationally via the Nova Player app and on DAB+ digital radio in Sydney, Melbourne and Brisbane.

smartfm.org.au.name: Smart FM
smartfm.org.au.about: Smart FM (3SFM) is a volunteer-run community radio station serving Swan Hill and surrounding districts in northern Victoria on 99.1 FM, with coverage extending roughly 50km from the town. It provides local news, music and airtime access for community groups and has broadcast for over 16 years.

smoothsailingradio.com.name: Smooth Sailing Radio
smoothsailingradio.com.about: Smooth Sailing Radio is a Melbourne-based internet radio station playing smooth 1970s and '80s hits, smooth jazz and Yacht Rock under the tagline "Smooth tunes for rough times."

snowfm.com.au.name: Snow FM
snowfm.com.au.about: Snow FM (callsign 2SKI) is a commercial radio station owned by Capital Radio Network, licensed to the Cooma/Jindabyne/Thredbo/Perisher Valley and Charlotte Pass area of the NSW Snowy Mountains. It provides local news, weather, and seasonal snow and road reports, and its digital service, Snow Digital, is simulcast into Canberra via DAB+.

sonshine.com.au.name: Sonshine FM
sonshine.com.au.about: Sonshine FM (6SON, 98.5 FM) is a non-profit Christian community radio station in Perth, Western Australia, that began broadcasting on Australia Day, January 1988. It plays adult contemporary and Christian music alongside news, talk segments and community guest interviews.

southcoastfm.au.name: South Coast FM
southcoastfm.au.about: South Coast FM is a community radio station based in Wonthaggi, Victoria, serving the South Gippsland and Bass Coast region with local news, information and music. The station was previously known as 3MFM.

sportfm.com.au.name: SportFM
sportfm.com.au.about: 91.3 SportFM is a Western Australian community radio station established in 2003 and based in Hamilton Hill, broadcasting to Fremantle, Cockburn and Melville. Run by Western Sports Media, it is dedicated to covering grassroots and under-exposed sports that receive limited coverage from mainstream commercial media.

stafm.com.au.name: STA FM
stafm.com.au.about: STA FM (91.9 FM) is a volunteer-run, not-for-profit community radio station based in Inverell, New South Wales, established in 2009, offering local news, community information and a broad music mix to the Inverell district.

star1019.com.au.name: Star 101.9
star1019.com.au.about: Star 101.9 (callsign 4MMK) is a commercial adult contemporary radio station in Mackay, Queensland, now owned by ARN. The FM station launched in 1999 as 4MK-FM, taking its call sign from a Mackay AM station dating back to 1931; it later traded as Zinc before being rebranded Star 101.9 in 2016 under Grant Broadcasters.

star1027.com.au.name: Star 102.7
star1027.com.au.about: Star 102.7 (callsign 4CCA) is a commercial adult contemporary radio station in Cairns, Queensland, now owned by ARN. Previously branded 4CA-FM and then Zinc 102.7 from 2009, it was rebranded Star 102.7 by Grant Broadcasters in 2016 before ARN acquired the station in 2021.

star1063.com.au.name: Star 106.3
star1063.com.au.about: Star 106.3 is a commercial Hot Adult Contemporary radio station in Townsville, Queensland, now owned by ARN. It was established as Mix FM in 1999 by RG Capital, later rebranded 106.3FM, then Star 106.3 in 2016 under Grant Broadcasters, aligning it with its sister Star stations in Mackay and Cairns.

starterfm.com.au.name: Starter FM
starterfm.com.au.about: Starter FM is an online dance-music station serving Western Sydney and the Hawkesbury, tracing its roots to a dedicated dance format at Pulse Radio starting in 2010. It shut down in 2014 and was relaunched as an online-only station under the Starter FM name in 2017; a brief 2021 temporary community licence for a youth format was revoked in 2022.

stationx.com.au.name: Station X - XRN Australia
stationx.com.au.about: Station X is the flagship stream of the X Radio Network (XRN Australia), operated from Wee Waa in northern NSW on 1611 AM and online. It plays a greatest-hits format spanning the 1960s to 2000s with hourly news bulletins.

xrn.com.au.name: Station X - XRN Australia
xrn.com.au.about: XRN Australia (The X Radio Network) broadcasts Station X from Wee Waa in northern NSW on 1611 AM and online, playing a greatest-hits format spanning the 1960s to 2000s with hourly news bulletins.

stereo10.net.name: Stereo 10
stereo10.net.about: Stereo 10 is an online revival of a Brisbane youth-oriented radio station that originally broadcast on 1008 AM from 1985 to 1988. Relaunched decades later as an internet radio station, it continues under the same Stereo 10 brand and name.

stream.thelight.com.au.name: 89.9 TheLight
stream.thelight.com.au.about: 89.9 TheLight (3TSC) is Melbourne's Christian community radio station, tracing its origins to Melbourne Christian Radio in 1977. Triple Seven Communications Inc was awarded a Melbourne-wide FM community licence on 89.9 in December 2001, and the station, now run by Positive Media Inc, broadcasts contemporary Christian music and talk on FM, DAB+ and online to more than a million listeners a month.

thelight.com.au.name: TheLight Mix
thelight.com.au.about: TheLight Mix is a digital-only sister stream of Melbourne's 89.9 TheLight (3TSC) Christian community station, run by Positive Media Inc (formerly Triple Seven Communications), offering a broader music mix alongside the flagship FM service.

thelight.org.au.name: TheLight Worship
thelight.org.au.about: TheLight (Worship) is a digital-only worship-music stream in the 89.9 TheLight family of Christian radio services run by Melbourne's Positive Media Inc, complementing the main 89.9 FM station and TheLight Mix stream.

thelightchristmas.com.au.name: TheLight Christmas
thelightchristmas.com.au.about: TheLight Christmas is a seasonal Christmas-music digital stream operated by Melbourne's 89.9 TheLight Christian community radio station (run by Positive Media Inc), playing festive music over the holiday period.

sunburyradio.com.au.name: Sunbury Radio
sunburyradio.com.au.about: Sunbury Radio (3NRG, 99.3 FM) is a volunteer-run community station serving Sunbury and Melbourne's outer north-west, including Diggers Rest, The Gap and Toolern Vale. It began in 1988 as 99.4 Bulla FM and rebranded as 3NRG in 1999 when it moved to 99.3 FM; in 2000 it entered the Guinness Book of Records for the world's longest DJ marathon.

sunshinefm.com.au.name: Sunshine FM 104.9
sunshinefm.com.au.about: Sunshine FM (4SFM, 104.9) is a not-for-profit community radio station serving the Sunshine Coast, Queensland, operated by Sunshine FM Radio Association Incorporated. It has broadcast a mix of music from the 1960s to today alongside local news and information for more than two decades.

supernova.com.au.name: Super Nova - Melbourne Radio
supernova.com.au.about: Super Nova is a Melbourne-based online radio station billing itself as "Melbourne's #1 Hit Music Station," playing current hits, throwbacks and remixes.

territoryfm.com.name: 104.1 Territory FM
territoryfm.com.about: 104.1 Territory FM (8TFM) is a community radio station broadcasting from the Charles Darwin University campus in Darwin, playing adult contemporary rock and mainstream music. It began broadcasting on 5 June 1981 (originally as 8CAR-FM, quickly renamed 8TOP-FM) after Darwin Community College lecturer John Potter proposed the idea in 1977, and added DAB+ digital broadcasting in 2016.

surffm.com.au.name: Surf FM
surffm.com.au.about: Surf FM (87.6 FM) is a narrowcast hot adult contemporary station serving Frankston and Casey in Melbourne's outer south-east, broadcasting from low-power transmitters in Seaford, Cranbourne, Berwick and Doveton. Its Frankston transmitter first switched on 1 October 2001.

sweetfm.com.au.name: Sweet FM
sweetfm.com.au.about: Sweet FM (97.1 FM) is a volunteer-run community radio station broadcasting 24/7 to the Burdekin region of Queensland from studios in Home Hill, on air since 1999. It provides music and talk programming and plays a key role relaying emergency and disaster information to the region.

swingtimeradio.com.name: Swingtime Radio
swingtimeradio.com.about: Swingtime Radio is an internet radio station based in Woy Woy, NSW, playing traditional jazz, swing, blues, gospel and vocal music from the 1920s to 1950s. It launched in 2014 as Jazzology Radio and features specialist programmes from Australian and UK presenters.

switchbrisbane.com.au.name: Switch Brisbane
switchbrisbane.com.au.about: Switch Brisbane is a community youth radio station run by the Brisbane Interactive Radio Group Inc. (BIRGI), founded in 1998, which began broadcasting on a high-power AM community licence (1197 kHz) in April 2003. The station has rebranded several times - Switch 1197 (2005), Brisbane Youth Radio/4YB (2017) - before reverting to the Switch Brisbane name in 2020 with a focus on dance, pop, R&B, hip-hop and electronic music.

swr999.com.au.name: SWR 99.9 FM
swr999.com.au.about: SWR 99.9 FM (2SWR) is a community radio station based in Blacktown serving Greater Western Sydney, first broadcasting full-time in 2003 after roots as an aspirant broadcaster in the 1980s and test transmissions from 1992. It plays an adult hits format ("70's to Now") and is run mostly by volunteers.

syd02.sdn.dhcmedia.com.au.name: Magic 87.6
syd02.sdn.dhcmedia.com.au.about: Magic 87.6 FM is a locally-owned open narrowcast radio service licensed for Mudgee, Gulgong and Kandos in the NSW central west, playing nostalgic hits spanning rock, pop, country and disco. It first went to air on 16 March 2020, owned and operated by Andrew Andrews.

systrum.net.name: Systrum Sistum - SSR1
systrum.net.about: Systrum Sistum (SSR1) is a Brisbane-based internet radio project playing ambient, drone, electronica, experimental and IDM music. It originally ran from 2003 to 2008 and was revived in 2018, operating jointly out of Brisbane and Budapest, Hungary.

tamarfm.net.name: Tamar FM
tamarfm.net.about: Tamar FM is a community radio station serving George Town and the Tamar Valley region of northern Tasmania, playing a range of music genres and taking listener requests. It also provides outside-broadcast coverage of local events.

tankfm.org.name: Tank FM
tankfm.org.about: Tank FM (103.1 FM) is Kempsey's community radio station, run entirely by volunteers through the Macleay Valley Community FM Radio Station Inc. It broadcasts an eclectic mix of easy listening, country, classic hits, gospel and rock alongside local community news, sport and weather for the Macleay Valley.

teabba.com.au.name: TEABBA Radio
teabba.com.au.about: TEABBA (Top End Aboriginal Bush Broadcasting Association) is an Indigenous broadcasting organisation providing operational support, training and 24/7 radio programming for 29 remote Indigenous broadcasting units (Remote Indigenous Broadcasting Services) across the Top End of the Northern Territory, from its Darwin studio.

tem-fm.com.au.name: TEM-FM
tem-fm.com.au.about: TEM-FM is a community radio station serving Temora and Ariah Park in the NSW Riverina, broadcasting on 102.5 FM (Temora) and 106.9 FM (Ariah Park). It has operated as a source of local community information and programming for around 15 years.

tenfm.org.au.name: Ten FM
tenfm.org.au.about: Ten FM is a community radio service jointly run by the Tenterfield & District Community FM Radio Association and the Stanthorpe & Granite Belt Community Radio Association, broadcasting on 89.7 FM to Tenterfield and NSW border country and on 98.7 FM to Stanthorpe and the Granite Belt in Queensland. It reaches an estimated 18,000-plus listeners across more than 10,000 square kilometres.

thebuzzz.com.au.name: The Buzzz
thebuzzz.com.au.about: The Buzzz is a Melbourne-based internet radio station billing itself as "Melbourne's Home of Classic Hits," playing 1970s and 1980s disco, rock and pop through shows such as "Back to the Seventies" and "Yacht Rock."

thelocalstation.com.au.name: Sounds of the Mountains
thelocalstation.com.au.about: Sounds of the Mountains (The Local Station) is a community radio service for the Snowy Valleys and Cootamundra-Gundagai Regional Council areas of NSW, broadcasting on 96.3 FM (Tumut), 94.3 FM (Gundagai and Talbingo) and 94.1 FM (Adelong). It is operated by Montreal Community Theatre Inc. and provides local song requests, community announcements and emergency information.

thevoiceofislam.com.au.name: Voice of Islam
thevoiceofislam.com.au.about: Voice of Islam is a community radio station based in Lakemba, Sydney, broadcasting on 87.6 FM (and 107.9 FM during Ramadan) to serve Sydney's Islamic community. Programming includes Quran recitation, Islamic lectures, live Friday sermons, talk shows and news.

threedradio.com.name: Three D Radio
threedradio.com.about: Three D Radio (93.7 FM) is a volunteer-run community radio station in Adelaide, founded in 1979 as 5MMM and renamed Three D Radio in 1993 after the Triple M name was sold to a national commercial network. Run by the Progressive Music Broadcasting Association with no paid staff, it airs over 60 diverse music and talk programs with quotas favouring Australian, South Australian and unsigned artists.

tlcfm.com.au.name: TLC FM
tlcfm.com.au.about: TLC FM (93.5 FM) is a 100% volunteer-run community radio station broadcasting since 1988 from a replica lighthouse on Pilot Hill in Yamba, serving the Lower Clarence Valley from Evans Head south to Minnie Water and inland to Grafton, plus a global online audience.

todayscountry94one.com.name: Todays Country 94one
todayscountry94one.com.about: Todays Country 94one (94.1 FM) is a volunteer-run community country music station based in Gosford, NSW, and a registered charity. It has won the Australian Country Music People's Choice Award for Most Popular Radio Station six times, including in 2025, and supports emerging country artists.

traxfm.org.au.name: Trax FM
traxfm.org.au.about: Trax FM is a community radio station serving Port Pirie and the surrounding region of South Australia, operated by Pirie Community Radio Broadcasters Inc. Alongside general music and local content, it carries Radio Reading (RPH) programming for print-handicapped listeners and a Radio Filipino segment.

trfm.com.au.name: TRFM
trfm.com.au.about: TRFM is a community radio station broadcasting to the Gippsland region of Victoria on 99.5 and 99.9 FM from Sale.

triplea.org.au.name: Triple A
triplea.org.au.about: Triple A (98.9 FM) is a Brisbane-based First Nations media organisation broadcasting Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander content, music and talk, alongside podcasts, advertising, media training and event services. The organisation marks over 30 years of broadcasting under the Brisbane Indigenous Media Association.

tripleafm.net.au.name: Triple A FM
tripleafm.net.au.about: Triple A FM (107.1 FM) is a community music and information station in Wagga Wagga, NSW, operated by Wagga Wagga Community Media Inc. since 1981, broadcasting 24/7 as "The Riverina's best music mix."

tripleh965fm.org.au.name: Triple H
tripleh965fm.org.au.about: Triple H (96.5 FM) is a community radio station run by Horsham & District Community FM Radio Inc., serving Horsham and the surrounding district in western Victoria as a member of the Community Broadcasting Association of Australia.

triplehfm.com.au.name: Triple H FM
triplehfm.com.au.about: Triple H FM (100.1 FM) is a community radio station based at the Wallarobba Arts and Cultural Centre in Hornsby, NSW, serving the Hornsby and Ku-ring-gai communities. Its multicultural programming includes shows in Filipino, Sri Lankan, Mandarin, Cantonese, Farsi and Azerbaijani, under the tagline "Living Local, Listening Local, Supporting Local."

triplejunearthed.com.name: triple j Unearthed
triplejunearthed.com.about: triple j Unearthed is an ABC-run digital and online radio station dedicated exclusively to unsigned and emerging Australian artists, grown out of triple j's Unearthed talent-discovery initiative that began in 1995. It operates as a standalone digital radio station distinct from the main triple j network.

triplet.com.au.name: Triple T
triplet.com.au.about: Triple T is a community radio station established in 1982, broadcasting live and local across Townsville, Hinchinbrook, Charters Towers and the lower Burdekin in North Queensland. A registered charity, it runs International Sunday and First Nations programming and offers broadcaster training for the community.

tripleu.org.au.name: Triple U
tripleu.org.au.about: Triple U is a community radio station serving the Shoalhaven region from Nowra, NSW, marking around four decades of broadcasting. It supports local music and culture through initiatives like "Young Sounds of the Shoalhaven" and its news service, The Wire.

tygafm.org.au.name: TYGA FM
tygafm.org.au.about: TYGA FM (98.9) is a community radio station serving the Derwent Valley and Southern Central Highlands of Tasmania, based around New Norfolk, with programming and community engagement including local events like the Derwent Valley Relay For Life.

ucfm.com.au.name: UCFM
ucfm.com.au.about: UCFM (87.8 FM) is the University of Canberra's student radio station, based at the university's Bruce campus and supported by the Faculty of Arts and Design. It gives journalism and media students hands-on training producing music, interview and community-discussion programming for the wider Canberra audience.

ultra106five.com.name: ultra106five
ultra106five.com.about: ultra106five is a Hobart-based Christian community radio station operated by Hope Foundation Communicators Inc., offering family-friendly music and talk programming with a "positive media perspective."

valleyfm.com.name: Valley FM
valleyfm.com.about: Valley FM (89.5 FM) is a community radio station serving the ACT under the tagline "The Voice of the Valley," a member of the Community Broadcasting Association of Australia supported by the Community Broadcasting Foundation.

valleyfm.org.au.name: Valley FM
valleyfm.org.au.about: Valley FM (97.9 FM) is a community radio station based in Forbes, NSW, broadcasting 24 hours a day to Forbes and Parkes with an older-style music mix from the 1950s to today, alongside local news, sport and information for the district.

vintagefm.com.au.name: Vintage FM
vintagefm.com.au.about: Vintage FM is a hyperlocal community-focused station broadcasting on 87.8 FM in Penrith and the Hawkesbury and 88.7 FM in Camden and Wollondilly, NSW, plus online. Managed by Dawson Street Media, it plays classic 1960s-80s music via local announcers and resumed broadcasting in the Penrith/Hawkesbury area in December 2024.

vision.org.au.name: Vision Christian Radio
vision.org.au.about: Vision Christian Radio is a national Christian radio network, owned by Vision Christian Media (an affiliate of United Christian Broadcasters), that first broadcast on 1 February 1999 as Vision FM from a single transmitter in Beaudesert, Queensland. It has since grown to more than 800 AM and FM transmitters across every mainland Australian state, plus satellite coverage of remote areas.

voicefm.org.au.name: Voice FM
voicefm.org.au.about: Voice FM (99.9 FM) is a volunteer-run community radio station operated by the Ballarat Community FM Radio Co-operative, serving Ballarat and district with local music, talk and specialty programming including reggae, Italian and blues shows, plus programming for the visually impaired. The station has marked around 40 years on air.

voxfm.org.au.name: VOX FM
voxfm.org.au.about: VOX FM (106.9 FM) is an Illawarra multicultural community radio station operated by Illawarra Community FM Broadcasters Ltd, broadcasting for more than 40 years with programming for Indigenous, Bosnian, Croatian, Cypriot, Dutch, Filipino, German, Greek, Indian, Irish, Macedonian, Maltese, Portuguese, Scottish, Serbian, Slovenian, Spanish, Polish and Arabic communities, alongside classic hits and current affairs.

waggaslifefm.com.name: Life FM
waggaslifefm.com.about: Life FM (101.9 FM) is a Christian community radio station in Wagga Wagga, NSW, run by Riverina Christian Radio Incorporated to serve local churches and the wider community with gospel-focused talk and music programming.

waringarrimedia.org.au.name: Waringarri Media
waringarrimedia.org.au.about: Waringarri Media is an Indigenous-owned media organisation based in Kununurra, Western Australia, and described as WA's oldest Aboriginal community radio station. Broadcasting on 693 AM and 102.1 FM plus online, its Waringarri Media Aboriginal Corporation serves communities across a roughly 300km radius spanning the WA/NT border, including remote stations and outback communities, with news, country music, gospel and Indigenous arts and culture programming.

wavefm.com.au.name: Wave FM
wavefm.com.au.about: Wave FM (96.5 FM) is a commercial radio station based in Warrawong, Wollongong, operated by Wollongong Broadcasters Pty Limited as part of the ARN network, providing local news, weather and entertainment for the Illawarra.

wayfm.org.au.name: 7WAY Way FM
wayfm.org.au.about: Way FM is a Launceston-based community radio station describing itself as "Your Positive Alternative," offering family-friendly music, talk and devotional programming for greater Launceston and northern Tasmania.

westbremerradio.com.name: West Bremer Radio
westbremerradio.com.about: West Bremer Radio is a local community radio station based in Ipswich, Queensland, providing local news, sport coverage of the Ipswich sporting scene, and a platform for regional musicians through programs such as "Sounds of the City."

wildhorsefm.com.name: Wild Horse FM
wildhorsefm.com.about: Wild Horse FM (99.7 FM) is a volunteer-run, not-for-profit community radio station based in Yarraman, Queensland, serving Yarraman, Blackbutt, Benarkin, Cooyar and South Nanango. It has operated for over two decades, providing local programming and companionship to the small South Burnett-region community.

wowfm.org.name: WOW FM
wowfm.org.about: WOW FM (100.5) is a volunteer-operated, not-for-profit community radio station based in Semaphore, broadcasting 24/7 across Adelaide's western suburbs.

wsfm.com.au.name: Gold 101.7 (formerly WSFM)
wsfm.com.au.about: Gold 101.7, formerly WSFM, is a commercial Sydney radio station now owned by ARN Media. It traces back to 2WS, which began broadcasting on AM in 1978, moved to FM on 101.7 MHz in 1993, was branded WSFM from 2001, and was renamed Gold 101.7 in January 2025, playing classic hits from the 1980s onward.

wz4liw.scahw.com.au.name: hit Central Queensland (4ROK)
wz4liw.scahw.com.au.about: hit Central Queensland (4ROK) is a commercial youth-skewing radio station serving the Rockhampton/Gladstone market, owned by Southern Cross Austereo as part of the Hit Network. It launched in October 2000 as Hot FM under DMG Regional Radio and was rebranded to the Hit Network name in September 2016.

yarravalleyfm.org.au.name: Yarra Valley FM
yarravalleyfm.org.au.about: Yarra Valley FM (99.1 FM) is a not-for-profit community radio station broadcasting from Healesville, Victoria, serving the Shires of Yarra Ranges, Cardinia and Murrindindi plus eastern Melbourne suburbs with locally produced community information and music programs run entirely by volunteers.

yassfm.org.name: Yass FM
yassfm.org.about: Yass FM (100.3 FM) is a volunteer-run community radio station serving the Yass Valley in NSW, operated by the Yass Community Radio Association Inc. It began on a temporary licence around the turn of the millennium and marked its 25th anniversary, providing local music, news, weather and community information.

yesca.st.name: Radio319.Rock
yesca.st.about: Radio319.Rock is an internet radio station based in the Lake Macquarie/Newcastle area of NSW, playing classic hits and classic rock from the 1960s to 2000s with breakfast, drive-time and specialty shows.

zinc96.com.au.name: Zinc 96.1
zinc96.com.au.about: Zinc 96.1 is a commercial radio station serving the Sunshine Coast, Queensland, from Maroochydore, operated by AMI Radio Pty Ltd as part of the ARN network, providing music, entertainment news and community and emergency information for the region.
